name: Ms. Sunita
school: PM SHRI GGSSS, Sonepat Murthal Adda (3490)
citation: Ms. Sunita is a dedicated and highly effective teacher whose work is marked by a holistic approach to education and active involvement in both her school and community. Teaching since 2014, she has consistently achieved excellent student results, overseen increased enrollment, and reduced dropout rates, particularly in Geography Beyond the classroom, she implemented NEP 2020 through joyful, project-based learning and technology integration. Her initiatives have led her school to achieve State-level cultural champion status and a third-place national ranking. As an active member of organizations such as the Red Cross and Hindustan Scout and Guide, she instills values of selfless service and civic responsibility in her students. She collaborates actively with colleagues to foster a cohesive learning environment, empowering students to become responsible, patriotic citizens while improving environmental practices and social awareness within the community.
core: Innovative pedagogy and promotion of civic responsibility.

name: Mr. Shashi Paul
school: GOVT. MODEL CENTRE, PRIMARY SCHOOL, Shamror
citation: Mr. Shashi Paul is a dedicated teacher who consistently enhances educational opportunities in resource-limited settings. His pedagogy focuses on multi-grade, multi-level strategies, joyful learning with low-cost aids, and fostering a collaborative and inclusive classroom environment. He institutionalized structured sports training, leading students to state-level success in chess and badminton. Students from underprivileged backgrounds have secured admissions to prestigious institutions like Lawrence School. Beyond the classroom, Mr. Paul is a committed grassroots innovator. He developed English workbooks, established ICT and experiential learning labs, and mobilized community support from NGOs and local clubs to improve school infrastructure. His efforts resulted in increased student enrollment, improved attendance, and a more child-friendly school environment, exemplifying his profound impact on students and the community.
core: Institutionalized structured sports training and innovative pedagogy.

name: Mr. Narinder Singh
citation: Mr. Narinder Singh demonstrated exceptional dedication and initiative in school development, transforming a struggling institution into a well-equipped learning environment. Recognizing the poor condition of existing facilities, he actively engaged with the community, mobilizing parents, former students, and various stakeholders to secure support and funding. This collaborative approach was crucial in establishing 15 new classrooms, complete with modern amenities. His efforts extended beyond basic infrastructure to include specialized facilities like an IT Park, smart library, math park, and even an herbal garden, indicating a holistic vision for student growth. The emphasis on practical learning is evident with the establishment of a traffic training park and various sports courts. Furthermore, the inclusion of essential utilities such as a water harvesting system, generator, and Wi-Fi highlights his commitment to providing a conducive learning atmosphere. The personal investment of working "12 to 16 hours" daily underscores his profound dedication, which directly resulted in over 20 percent annual increase in school enrolment, showcasing the tangible impact of his leadership and tireless work.
core: Development of the School as a holistic educational ecosystem.

name: Mr. Awadhesh Kumar Jha
citation: Mr. Jha has launched an innovative initiative, “Dil ki baat”, to connect with students of Classes 5, 6, 9, and 12, offering them a safe environment to share their thoughts without being judged. He established the Zero Waste Citizen Bank, where students deposit dry waste to inculcate the philosophy of Reduce, Reuse, and Recycle. He created the ‘Shobhit Reading Room’, accommodating 70 students, accessible from 8 am to 8 pm on all 365 days, providing access to books, computers, and the internet. To foster joyful learning, he set up an Activity Room, a COVID-time Stress Buster Room, and a Junior Science Lab with NGO support, resulting in emotional well-being and hands-on learning. Mr. Jha also established a Heart-to-Heart Lounge to support personality development, time management, communication skills, and meditation.
core: Psychosocial support and socio-emotional learning.

name: Ms. Manjubala
citation: Ms. Manjubala, the Principal of a Government Primary School in a remote area of Uttarakhand, has demonstrated a strong commitment to education. She has spearheaded innovative initiatives aligned with the National Education Policy 2020, promoting mother-tongue-based teaching, creating an inclusive learning environment, and utilizing activity-based methods to foster critical thinking. She strengthened Foundational Literacy and Numeracy through engaging TLM-based activities, developed a continuous assessment system for remedial support, ensuring all students achieve proficiency. She has leveraged technology, including smart classrooms and digital teaching materials, established a safe school environment through platforms like Bal Sabha, and organized awareness campaigns on menstrual hygiene and child marriage to empower girls. Her contributions have earned numerous accolades, including the Anmol Ratna Award, Teacher of the Year 2020 by the State HRD, Best Social Worker, and the title of Iron Lady from a national-level Human Rights Organization.
core: Democratization of school processes and Foundational Literacy and Numeracy

name: Ms. Parveen Kumari
school: Government Girls Model Senior Secondary School
citation: Ms. Parveen Kumari is instrumental in showcasing a teaching philosophy that is dynamic and student-centered, moving beyond traditional methods. She effectively uses hands-on projects, such as an herbal nursery and a kitchen garden, to connect theoretical knowledge with practical application and foster a sense of environmental responsibility. Her integration of technology is another key element, demonstrated by the two YouTube channels she has launched to provide accessible and engaging learning content. Ms. Kumari’s teaching approach prioritizes 21st-century skills, utilizing innovative tools like a "broken spherical structure" to make history lessons more engaging and interactive. She also organizes educational excursions to provide students with real-world learning experiences. Through these diverse strategies, Ms. Parveen Kumari demonstrates her dedication to nurturing well-rounded and inquisitive individuals.
core: Innovative pedagogic approach and use of ICT

name: Ms. Neelam Yadav
citation: Ms. Neelam Yadav is a committed educator and school leader who has driven remarkable transformation at her school. Her leadership has resulted in consistently excellent academic results, including 100% board class results for four consecutive years and multiple district toppers. To overcome resource limitations, she successfully secured CSR funding for a digital lab with 60 tablets and smart classrooms, bridging the digital divide and creating an engaging learning environment. She implemented "No Bag Day" with hands-on activities, organized career counselling, and established a STEM lab. Her efforts in co-curricular activities have led to students winning numerous awards, including the Gargi award for academic excellence and bronze in state-level wrestling.
core: Bridging the digital divide and inculcation of scientific temper

name: Ms. Bhaviniben Dineshbhai Desai
addr: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu - 396210
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
citation: Ms. Bhaviniben Dineshbhai Desai, a dedicated educator with over 26 years of service at GUPS Bhensroad, has demonstrated exceptional leadership and commitment. As an In-charge Head Teacher, she has actively contributed to various Government duties and held key roles like Complex Head and Sports Convener. Her innovative teaching methods include using smart TVs and creating low-cost teaching aids from waste materials. These efforts have not only enhanced learning but also led to her school winning the District Champion Shield in sports for four consecutive years. She has successfully reduced student dropouts through community engagement and parental awareness. During the COVID-19 pandemic, her dedication was reflected as she delivered rations and provided home-based learning. Smt. Desai's first-place win at the Daman Innovation Fair highlights her continuous pursuit of educational excellence.
core: Community engagement and parental awareness

name: Mr. Vilas Ramnath Satarkar
school: Dr. K. B. Hedgewar High School, Cujira Bambolim
citation: Mr. Vilas Ramnath Satarkar, the Headmaster of Dr. K. B. Hedgewar High School, has dedicated over 29 years to education. He has taken a proactive approach, focusing on inclusive education, establishing an academic resource room for students with special needs, and implementing mentorship programs that extend through higher education. Mr. Vilas has also been a key figure in educational policy, serving on the State Level Steering Committee for NEP 2020 and as President of the Goa Headmasters Association. He actively promotes cultural literacy, community engagement, and civic responsibility by organizing blood donation drives and enhancing school infrastructure through CSR initiatives. His numerous recognitions, including the State Teachers Award 2021 and Lokmat Goan of the Year 2024, affirm his impactful contributions to education.
core: Leadership in education and community engagement

name: Mr. Hitesh Kumar Pravinchandra Bhundiya
citation: Mr. Hitesh Kumar Pravinchandra Bhundiya is a highly accomplished science educator and Headmaster at Shri Swaminarayan Gurukul Vidyalaya, with a career marked by innovation, mentorship, and a deep commitment to student development. His journey began as a Junior Scientist, and he has become a key figure in promoting hands-on, experiential science education. He secured a ₹20 lakh grant to establish an Atal Tinkering Lab (ATL), enabling his students to compete and win awards in national and international events like the World's Biggest Robotic Olympiad. His mentorship has inspired students to excel, including a student receiving a research patent for a cotton spinning machine prototype, and others representing India at international science fairs. Beyond the classroom, Mr. Hitesh Kumar has contributed significantly to the community, including designing a patented alkaline water filter and organizing initiatives like "Vigyan Safar" and water recharge projects. During the COVID-19 pandemic, he created interactive educational videos to ensure continuous learning. His dedication has been recognized with numerous accolades, including the Gujarat State Best Teacher Award and the Skillprint Science Excellence Award, affirming his transformative impact on students and the broader community.
core: STEM promotion and patent intellectual property rights.

name: Mr. Hirenkumar Hasmukhbhai Sharma
citation: Mr. Hirenkumar is an innovative teacher who has consistently focused on the holistic development of his students by integrating traditional values with modern teaching methods. His learner-centric approach is reflected in the development and implementation of activity-based learning modules, the creation of localized educational content in Gujarati, and the strategic use of digital tools like DIKSHA and YouTube to enhance classroom engagement. He has a strong commitment to fostering scientific thinking by encouraging students to participate in various science exhibitions, competitive programs like the Inspire Awards, and scholarship exams such as NMMS and Gyan Sadhana. These initiatives have led to admission of students in prestigious institutions and State-level recognition for him.
core: Innovative pedagogy and inculcation of scientific temper.

name: Ms. Sheela Patel
citation: Ms. Sheela Patel is a primary teacher who has made significant contributions to her school and community by creating an enjoyable and child-friendly learning environment. She is especially dedicated to inclusive and community-based education. She has consistently achieved a 100% exam result by ensuring regular attendance, even using her own vehicle to bring students to school. She is a pioneer in implementing FLN (Foundational Literacy and Numeracy) activities, creating zero-cost TLMs, and engaging mothers in FLN workshops to extend learning into the home. Her innovative use of technology, such as showing educational videos on tablets and laptops and using QR codes to provide information about plants, has made learning more engaging. Beyond the classroom, she has initiated educational panels and "learning palaces" in local communities, organized summer and winter camps for students, and conducted women's literacy classes during holidays. Her efforts have not only improved the academic results of students but have also instilled social values and a sense of community responsibility.
core: Community-centric approach, blending innovative FLN methods.

name: Mr. Bherulal Osara
citation: Mr. Bherulal Osara’s comprehensive and innovative approach to education extends beyond the classroom. His pedagogical methods, such as play-based, collaborative, and project-based learning, created an engaging environment for students. The flipped classroom model and daily activities like ‘exit tickets’ encouraged critical thinking and active participation. He focused on holistic student development, engaging parents and improving school management through initiatives like PTM-based monitoring and self-attendance tracking.
core: Innovative pedagogy and community engagement.

name: Dr. Pragya Singh
citation: Dr. Pragya Singh has spent 17 years as a significant force in rural education, tackling issues like parental drug addiction and lack of educational awareness. Her efforts began by engaging parents, particularly mothers, leading to a remarkable 100% attendance rate for girls. She is an educational innovator, having created a self-funded "Adarsh Math Lab" and a "Maths Park" to make learning joyful. She also developed an "Ullas Kendra" using everyday household items to teach basic literacy and numeracy. This dedication has yielded exceptional academic results, with 23 students selected for NMMSE and others for prestigious institutions like Shrestha and Prayas. Beyond the classroom, Dr. Singh has led impactful social campaigns on drug eradication and girl education, securing corporate partnerships for initiatives like the free distribution of sanitary napkins.
core: Educational awareness and 100% attendance rate for girls.

name: Mr. Kuldeep Gupta
citation: Mr. Kuldeep Gupta, an educator since 1992, has a deep commitment to innovative, experiential learning. He is known for creating low-cost teaching aids and mentoring students for national competitions like the National Children Science Congress, successfully representing the Jammu Division. He serves as a resource person for DIET Jammu and JKSCERT. Mr. Gupta has significantly improved school enrolment and reduced dropout rates through proactive community engagement. His dedication to student counselling, drug de-addiction awareness, and focus on academic excellence has earned him district and state-level recognition.
core: Community engagement.

name: Mr. Ram Lal Singh Yadav
citation: Mr. Ram Lal Singh Yadav is a dedicated educator who has transformed a rural school into a Center of Excellence through innovation and community engagement. By pioneering ICT-based smart classes and enrolling his own children in the school, he built a strong foundation of trust and modernized the learning environment. This commitment has led to remarkable student success, with over 153 students securing national scholarships—a clear testament to the school's high academic standards. His efforts also earned the school the prestigious Utkrishta Vidyalaya Award twice.
core: Created a high-performing academic environment.

name: Ms. Madhurima Tiwari
school: P M Shri Composite Vidyalaya Rani Karnawati
citation: Ms. Madhurima Tiwari has made a significant contribution to education by transforming a dilapidated school into a modern, thriving institution. Her journey began in rural areas, where enrolment increased and infrastructure improved. After being transferred to Rani Karnawati Primary School, she revitalized a nearly ruined campus with low student enrolment. She also pioneered a "green school" initiative, which earned the school a Green School Award. Her dedication has led to a significant increase in enrolment.
core: Transforming a dilapidated school into a vibrant school.

name: Ms. Kumari Nidhi
citation: Ms. Kumari Nidhi is a grassroots enabler who uses teaching as a powerful tool for social upliftment in marginalized communities. She turned landless schools into thriving institutions through her resourceful approach. She created the "Nipun Balmanch," a child-centric learning model that inspired a state-level e-magazine and made education joyful and effective. Her social initiatives have prevented dozens of girls from child marriage and re-enrolled them in school by mobilizing the community through campaigns like "Our School Our Responsibility," which built and sustained school infrastructure. Her efforts have resulted in remarkable student retention and high FLN proficiency, earning her recognition in the India Book of Records.
core: Systemic change in education.

name: Mr. Dilip Kumar
school: Lalit Narayan Laxmi Narayan Project Girls High School
citation: Mr. Dilip Kumar’s core contribution is his dedication to cultivating scientific thinking and a passion for STEM among students. He has guided students to achieve success at state and national levels, primarily through activity-based learning and the innovative use of technology. His efforts to bridge the digital divide have been particularly impactful, equipping students with skills to use digital tools and modern technology. By establishing an Atal Tinkering Lab, he provides students with a dynamic platform to work on projects, boosting their confidence and preparing them for future careers in science and technology.
core: Cultivating scientific thinking and a passion for STEM among students.

name: Ms. Sonia Vikas Kapoor
citation: Ms. Sonia Vikas Kapoor is a dedicated teacher who champions holistic development by blending innovative pedagogical approaches with life skills and values. Her teaching strategies, like cooperative learning and art-integrated learning, are commendable. Her dedication is also reflected in her book, Teach to Enrich , and articles on inclusive education and cooperative learning. Other initiatives include "Primary Pitara" and a repository of self-made TLMs to transform substitution periods into meaningful learning opportunities. She also established an "Open Library" to foster reading and multilingualism. Beyond academics, Ms. Kapoor is committed to nurturing students' character and well-being, inspired by the ‘Prerana Programme’.
core: Creation of an innovative Teaching Learning Environment.

name: Mr. Kandhan Kumaresan
school: Govt. Model Senior Secondary School Aberdeen
citation: Mr. Kandhan Kumaresan is a primary school teacher whose work ethic is a testimony to his commitment to community-rooted pedagogy. He reinforces textbook learning with students' lived experiences by using local folklore, songs, and games. His innovative approach includes activities where students document local vegetation, encouraging observation and environmental awareness. Despite various challenges, he has effectively integrated technology into his teaching, shifting ICT labs to the primary section and creating WhatsApp-based learning modules. His belief in inclusivity is a hallmark of his work, designing differentiated learning plans for students with special needs. His support for Children with Special Needs (CwSN) has led to student successes in music. His leadership also extends to securing significant CSR partnerships to bring Atal Tinkering Labs, ICT Labs, and solar panels to schools.
core: Inclusive pedagogy.

name: Mr. Santosh Kumar Chaurasia
school: PM SHRI School Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Salora
citation: Mr. Santosh Kumar Chaurasia has an illustrious career mentoring students, helping over 50 students gain admission to prestigious IITs and medical colleges. He serves as a Resource Person and Master Facilitator, training teachers in experiential and innovative pedagogies. Passionate about chemistry, he has developed over 50 interactive chemistry games on Word Wall, making learning engaging and ICT-driven. Beyond teaching, he is an accomplished writer, authoring books on the impact of mobile phones on children's concentration and exploring women's roles in modern India.
core: Use of innovative and ICT pedagogy.

name: Dr. Pramod Kumar
citation: Dr. Pramod Kumar is a multi-faceted educator with over 28 years of experience, consistently achieving 100% board results in Biology. He serves as a CBSE Resource Person, CBSE Master Trainer, and NEP 2020 Ambassador, training over 250,000 teachers on pedagogy, gender sensitization, and NEP implementation. As a trained counsellor, he actively supports students’ psychosocial and career development. His distinguished work has earned him multiple awards, including the CBSE National Teachers Awards 2020, and he has represented India at the Global Inclusive Schools Forum in Paris.
core: Psychosocial support and academic achievement of students.

name: Mr. Tarun Kumar Dash
citation: Mr. Tarun Kumar Dash is a trailblazer in education, fostering creativity and social awareness. Initiatives like the "Katha Chitra" project empower students as storytellers and filmmakers, while "My Reading Book and My Picture My Story" encourages children to author and illustrate their own books. The "News Nest" initiative develops vocabulary and summarization skills, and the "Mai Bhi Speaker" forum builds confidence and communication abilities. He also led the "Millet Kranti" campaign, raising awareness of millet nutrition through rallies and introducing weekly millet meals at his school, promoting healthy eating habits and local culture. These efforts reflect his vision of holistic student development—academic, creative, and socially conscious.
core: Innovative pedagogy and contribution to language teaching.

name: Mr. Basanta Kumar Rana
citation: Mr. Basanta Kumar Rana’s contributions in the aspirational district of Malkangiri go beyond traditional teaching, creating significant improvements in student attendance and community engagement. He uses creative, low-cost methods to bridge the gap between the school and society. He organized awareness rallies, road shows, and puppet shows to communicate the importance of education. To foster a reading culture, he established a monthly community library, bringing books to different villages by bicycle, and successfully re-enrolled children who had dropped out. Mr. Rana transformed his school into a dynamic learning environment by implementing BaLA (Building as Learning Aid) initiatives like "talking walls" and a "stone alphabet and number garden," turning the entire campus into an interactive educational space. These walls, adorned with educational charts, creative artwork, and learning aids, actively engage students from Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) to more complex concepts, demonstrating innovation born from resource scarcity.
core: Innovative pedagogy and community engagement for students’ attendance.

name: Ms. Tanusree Das
citation: Ms. Tanusree Das is an innovative and dedicated teacher whose work brings transformative change in the educational life cycle of children. She engages both students and mothers, instituting recognition for mothers through the “Mother of the Year Award.” When she joined Kuchlachati, the village faced low enrolment, high dropout rates, and early marriages for girls. Through her innovative teaching methods, she transformed the school into a hub of change for the community, achieving zero dropouts since 2016. Her initiatives, including the Nari Shakti Group and student support programs, not only improved academics but also addressed critical social issues like child marriage and domestic violence. She also started a school bank using piggy banks at the time of admission to prepare students for future financial responsibility. Ms. Tanusree’s mission is to use education as a tool for social reform, developing responsible and capable citizens who contribute positively to society.
core: Innovative teaching pedagogy and teaching for broader social reform.

name: Ms. Nang Ekthani Mounglang
school: Govt. Sec. School Pachin, Papum Pare
citation: Ms. Nang Ekthani Mounglang is renowned for her leadership and dedication as Headmaster. Upon joining the institution, she faced a challenging environment, yet through consistent supervision, hard work, and well-planned mock tests, she raised the Class X CBSE result from 27% to 81.54% in 2024 and achieved an extraordinary 100% in 2025. This made her school the first government institution in the capital of Arunachal Pradesh to reach this milestone. She created a blended learning environment with ICT-integrated classrooms, making learning more practical and hands-on. Ms. Mounglang expanded the range of activities and responsibilities to promote holistic development in alignment with NEP 2020. She also led extensive community engagement programs, including regular PTMs, POCSO and drug abuse awareness campaigns, legal awareness initiatives, and Craft Melas, involving parents and the community significantly. Her professional engagement with SCERT Itanagar in textbook and module preparation, along with rigorous training for textbook development, exemplifies her relentless pursuit of professional excellence.
core: Exceptional leadership and innovative pedagogy.

name: Ms. Peleno Petenilhu
school: John Govt. Higher Secondary School, Viswema, Kohima
citation: Ms. Peleno Petenilhu’s classroom transcends walls and rigid syllabi; it is a living space of joy, shared responsibility, empathy, and transformation. She has created a learning environment rooted in joy, empathy, and relevance, particularly for students facing adversity. A hallmark of her teaching is the “Each One Teach One” initiative, a peer learning model where Class 12 students mentor juniors or academically struggling students. She connects English lessons to local folktales and real-life issues to promote critical thinking, expression, and contextual understanding. Thematic poetry, peer reviews, mock interviews, and panel discussions further deepen comprehension and foster confidence among students, making learning both relevant and transformative.
core: Contextualization of English with folk tales.

name: Ms. Koijam Machasana
school: Ghari Upper Primary School, Imphal West
citation: Ms. Koijam Machasana is a visionary leader who identifies challenges and devises strategies to address them. Her revolutionary leadership as a school headmaster began with an honest assessment of issues like parental suspicion, weak community partnership, and skill-building learning deficits. Her most effective strategy was innovative community engagement, particularly focused on Early Childhood Care and Education (ECCE). She directly engaged young mothers in the neighborhood, teaching them NEP and ECCE principles. This initiative not only established a thriving pre-primary wing but also fostered cooperation and trust, creating a dedicated, collaborative community. Her work demonstrates how people-centric planning can transform adversity into profound success.
core: People-focused planning and involving mothers in Early Childhood Care and Education.

name: Mr. Karma Tempo Ethenpa
citation: Mr. Karma Tempo Ethenpa is celebrated for his energetic leadership and contributions to holistic student development. A retired state football player and athlete, he channels his passion into coaching school football and volleyball teams to championship victories. Beyond sports, he addresses youth challenges like tobacco, cigarette, and technology addiction by providing healthy alternatives. An avid photographer, he encourages students to master mobile photography and visual storytelling, fostering appreciation for nature and generating school revenue through exhibitions. His curriculum design experience includes authoring English textbooks for SCERT Sikkim. Additionally, he spearheaded innovative green projects like rainwater harvesting and a vertical garden, and introduced a complete Pipers Band, reflecting his commitment to comprehensive education and vibrant school life.
core: Integration of Sports and Arts in education.

name: Dr. Heipor Uni Bang
citation: Dr. Heipor Uni Bang is a distinguished teacher awarded the State Award 2024 by the Government of Meghalaya. He is a prolific author of three books—Guidebook Health Education Class X SSLC MBOSE, Ki Khlur Rit Khasi Book IV, and General Knowledge for classes 1–3—along with many publications. His classroom integrates technology and innovative pedagogy to cultivate independent learners with strong social interaction and critical life skills. His teaching employs flow charts, diagrams, maps, geometrical instruments, experimental projects, computers, and digital TVs to make learning engaging and interactive. His exceptional work with Children with Special Needs (CwSN) is especially commendable. Dr. Bang’s relentless dedication, innovative spirit, and unwavering commitment to his students and community make him a beacon of educational excellence in remote regions.
core: Inclusive and innovative pedagogy.

name: Ms. Bidisha Majumder
citation: Ms. Bidisha Majumdar is a visionary teacher renowned for her pioneering efforts in promoting scientific temper and innovation. Under her guidance, students have excelled at INSPIRE Awards MANAK and the National Children's Science Congress (NCSC). She has also helped students participate in advanced programs such as ISRO YUVIKA and the Wipro Earthian Programme, fostering interest in science and sustainability. Beyond the classroom, Ms. Majumdar demonstrates exemplary social responsibility. She coaches orphanage children, conducts awareness campaigns against child marriage using innovative methods like street plays, and strongly advocates for inclusive education. Her work nurtures a generation of intellectually competent and morally strong citizens.
core: Inculcating a Scientific temperament, community awareness, and engagement.

name: Mr. Debajit Ghosh
citation: Mr. Debajit Ghosh is an exceptional and dedicated teacher whose tireless efforts have profoundly transformed Namsang TE Model School, a remote location without road connectivity or basic communication facilities. His leadership has yielded remarkable results. Through a unique science exhibition organized with VSSE SAC and ISRO, he fostered a love for learning, which significantly reduced student absenteeism. He addressed critical health issues after a camp revealed high undernutrition rates by improving the PM-POSHAN program—introducing green leafy vegetables and supplements, raising hemoglobin levels for 165 students. Under his guidance, HSLC results improved from 78% to 90%, and students now confidently participate in sports and music competitions. Mr. Ghosh’s unwavering commitment to students’ academic, physical, and emotional well-being exemplifies visionary leadership.
core: Lead the health initiatives in schools.

name: Ms. Shweta Sharma
citation: Ms. Shweta Sharma is a dedicated government schoolteacher from Jharkhand with over two decades of experience, whose work embodies the vision of NEP 2020. Her journey is marked by a deep commitment to foundational learning, child-friendly pedagogy, and community engagement. Beginning her career at a rural school on the verge of closure, Shweta’s efforts to create a warm, joyful learning environment increased enrolment within two years. She applied play-way methods and activity-based learning, building strong foundational skills in reading, writing, and numeracy. A key innovator, she has contributed to state-level educational initiatives, including developing teaching materials and textbooks for Jharkhand. Her most cherished contribution is the "Abua Jadui Pitara," a localized, toy-based learning kit inspired by the state's tribal heritage, successfully adopted by other teachers. During the COVID-19 pandemic, she co-founded the "Copy Exchange Program," a peer-to-peer note-sharing network that earned a Pramerica International Award and led to her students' participation in a UN Youth Programme. Her dedication to professional development and collaboration, along with state and national awards, cements her reputation as a transformative educator committed to ensuring every child thrives.
core: Used innovative pedagogy for the retention of students.

name: Dr. Shaikh Mohammad Waquioddin Shaikh Hamidoddin
citation: Dr. Shaikh Mohammad Waquioddin Shaikh Hamidoddin is a dedicated educator with over 28 years of service who has profoundly impacted his school and community. As Headmaster and Science Teacher at Zilla Parishad High School, he transformed the institution into a hub of academic excellence and social reform. His core contributions include successfully tackling a girl student dropout crisis in a marginalized community by establishing a temporary school branch, providing safe education to over 2,000 girls. He is also a pioneer in health initiatives, launching a mission to distribute over 5 lakh sanitary napkins and installing a vending machine on school premises. Dr. Shaikh has actively mobilized the community to raise over ₹50 lakh for school infrastructure and resources, including digital tools and a Caring Classroom Policy. His exemplary work in promoting academic rigor, social awareness, and communal harmony earned him the prestigious State Teacher Award in 2018, the prize money of which he donated entirely back to his school.
core: Reduced girls' dropout rate and developed the academic excellence hub.

name: Dr. Sandipan Gurunath Jagdale
citation: Dr. Sandipan Gurunath Jagdale is a dedicated teacher at Dayanand College of Arts, Latur, with over two decades of service. He has acted as a social transformer through education, combining pedagogical innovation, digital technology, and inclusivity. He is particularly lauded for pioneering accessible learning materials, such as the first-ever Braille book for visually impaired students and an FLN book in a local dialect. He also leverages technology to reach lakhs of students for free. His mentorship ensures a 100% success rate and propels students from marginalized backgrounds to national and international recognition, including Guinness World Records and prestigious societal roles.
core: Education as a tool for social transformation

name: Mr. Ibrahim S.
citation: Mr. Ibrahim S. is a compassionate Headmaster, has dedicated his career to nurturing students' social, emotional, and academic well-being. Through personalized intervention, he has made remarkable efforts to transform student lives. His efforts to visit homes, build trust, and offer unwavering support have successfully brought students back to school, enabling them to complete their education and build meaningful lives. He uses different strategies to help children overcome behavioral and emotional difficulties. Beyond individual mentorship, he has created a nurturing school ecosystem. His initiatives, including a Green Library, play corners, a nail-cutting area, and a "One Plant for One Student" project, promote health, creativity, and environmental awareness. He has also strengthened community bonds through initiatives like "Tithi Bhojan" and a publicly displayed Statistical Board, demonstrating a deep commitment to holistic education and the collective spirit of his school community.
core: Community engagement and socio-emotional learning.

name: Ms. Madhurima Acharya
citation: Ms. Madhurima Acharya is an active Computer Teacher who incorporates ICT tools, project-based learning, flipped classrooms, coding platforms, and real-life simulations to make learning engaging and meaningful. She has developed low-cost and no-cost teaching materials using open-source software to ensure inclusive learning. A key initiative of hers is linking theoretical concepts to real-world applications, especially in Computer Science, Robotics, and AI, to foster curiosity and innovation. Her students have developed projects such as an Automatic Plant Watering System, an Advanced Drive Assistance System, and Line Follower Robots, many of which received recognition at innovation festivals.
core: Innovative pedagogy using ICT and open-source software

name: Ms. Madabathula Thirumala Sridevi
citation: Ms. Madabathula Thirumala Sridevi has transformed classrooms that often stifle curiosity into student-centric learning environments, with technology as a powerful tool. She integrated Chromebooks, projectors, and interactive tablets to turn classrooms into dynamic launchpads for discovery. She implemented a paperless system for assessments and assignments, saving time and resources while teaching essential digital literacy skills. Her innovative initiatives, including the Talking Robot project, gained recognition from both national and international media, including BBC News. Ms. Sridevi also organized a Mega Parent Teacher Meeting 2.0 with activities like Rangoli for mothers and Tug of War for fathers, making parents active partners in their children’s education. She is the recipient of the State Best Teacher Savitribai Phule Award and the State Best Headmistress Award.
core: Innovative pedagogy in school science

name: Ms. Maram Pavithra
citation: Ms. Maram Pavithra has been actively participating in State-level projects since 2017, including mushroom cultivation, eco-innovation, water conservation, and sustainable farming. She spearheads the “Vidya Varadhi” programme, where her students interact with students from Pennsylvania, USA. name: Ms. Revathy Parameswaran
school: P S Senior Secondary School, Chennai
citation: Ms. Revathy Parameswaran was appreciated by the United States Department of State for the Capstone Project on formative assessments and taught at a school in Maryland, USA. Ms. Revathy played a pivotal role in developing a state-of-the-art STEM lab equipped with IoT modules, 3D printing technology, and robotics kits, giving students practical exposure to cutting-edge innovations. Her students have won several prizes in annual Robotics League competitions, designing wireless robots from scratch. Through a partnership with IIT Madras, the School Connect Programme offers students exposure to Data Science, Design Thinking, and Electronics.
core: STEM education using ICT

citation: Ms. Vijayalakshmi V is pioneering in adopting experiential learning methods such as field visits to archaeological sites, practical demonstrations using everyday materials, and integration of digital tools to enhance understanding. Her efforts have focused on acquiring digital literacy and fostering collaborative learning environments among teachers. As a member of the Child Protection Committee and Women Protection Committee of Udumalpet Municipal Council, she has worked to safeguard the rights and well-being of children. She has organized health camps, menstrual hygiene awareness sessions, and nutritional guidance programs to support adolescent girls. Under her mentorship, alumni contributions have supported scholarships and awards. school: PATHSALA SENIOR SECONDARY SCHOOL, MUGURIA PATHSALAL, BAJALI ASSAM - 781325
citation: A dedicated teacher for 35 years, Shri. Kumud Kalita played a vital role in establishing a residential school for the especially abled children. He has organized book fairs and awareness drives in his district. He received the Assam Chief Minister Best Community Action Award. He has authored several books including books for children. He has been a teacher, mentor and social service worker representing the qualities of compassion and dedication. He plays a crucial role in social welfare as a member of Juvenile Justice Board and Sishu Kalyan Samiti in preventing child marriage, child labour, women and child trafficking, etc. He employs innovative methods like music and joy in offering therapy to differently abled children.
core: Governance

name: Mr. Jose D Sujeev
school: GOVERNMENT MODEL GIRLS HIGHER SECONDARY SCHOOL PATTOM, THIRUVANANTHAPURAM KERALA - 695004
citation: As an educator, Shri .Jose D Sujeev introduced interactive and creative activities in his classroom, for example, Let’s Build Vocabulary, On This Day and an activity book for second language learners. He organized workshops and training sessions for teachers from different schools. He created a strong bond between the school and the community by initiating educational visits and environmental programs. He offered free online video classes to SSLC examination aspirants and even made DVDs and resource CDs to various grade levels, including hearing impaired students, thus ensuring inclusivity in language education. He developed an activity package of 28 modules for the learners to familiarize themselves with basic language skills. He is also a member of various teams of Government of Kerala furthering cause of education.
core: Use of technology for learning

name: Mr. Mekala Bhaskar Rao
school: MCPS KONDAYAPALEM SW, SC COLONY KONDAYAPALEM, 20 TH DIVISON, SPSR NELLORE ANDHRA PRADESH - 524004
citation: Due to the efforts of Shri.M Bhaskar Rao and with the help from Government and donors, his school got infrastructure worth Rs. 20 lakhs. It consisted of toilets, additional classrooms, compound wall, grill, drinking water facility etc. He tackled the problem of dropouts in his district along with other teachers by visiting the houses of the students and understanding their problems. His school is one of the few schools to introduce digital technology in teaching. The useof computer education made the children to think more creatively and more intelligently. He conducts awareness programs in his school through rallies and participatory activities on different issues like child labour, child marriage, clean and green environment, etc.
core: Engagement of community

name: Ms. MURAHARA RAO UMA GANDHI
school: GVMCP SCHOOL, SIVAJIPALEM, 21, VISAKHAPATNAM ANDHRA PRADESH - 530017
citation: Apart from being a teacher, Smt. MURAHARA RAO UMA GANDHI is a yoga practitioner too. She teaches yoga and meditationfree of cost with focus on under-privileged people. TEACHING AT THE RIGHT LEVEL was one of the programs that her school launchedwhere they visited the homes of students and taught various important things inlife. With the help of an online website FROOTS she hasorganised online sessions during the summer vacation to narrate stories, rhymes andto conduct various other activities. She has also translated three English books into Telugu which were published by NBT. She has served as a member for the development ofbalasahithyam and integrating joyful learning with TLM. She has curated teaching modules and written severalpoems for students.

For better understanding of concepts, he has used visual aids like charts, diagrams and models. By regular assessments of students, he identifies areas where students need additional support, tracks students’ progress over time with the help of parents and local community. He has given guidanceto students preparing for Navodaya Vidyalaya,Sainik School and Residential School entrance exams. For this he got an appreciation from the District Administration also.
core: Innovative pedagogy and joyful learning

name: Ms. Archana Nooguri
school: MPPS REBBANAPALLY, REBBANPALLY, LUXETTIPET, MANCHERIAL TELANGANA - 504215

Archana Nooguri’s primary focus has been to improve enrolment rates and reduce dropouts in the schools by raising awareness about facilities provided by government among parents and villagers. She provided digital learningexperiences to children to ensure joyful learning. The development and use of low-cost Teaching LearningMaterial have been central to her approach as aneducator. Two of her papers have been published in international journals. She authored a book on Transforming India by means of National Education Policy 2020.
core: Innovative pedagogy and joyful learning

name: Mr. Santhosh Kumar Bhedodkar
school: MANDAL PARISHAD UPPER PRIMARY SCHOOL NIPANI, BHEEMPUR, ADILABAD TELANGANA - 504312
citation: Throughout 18 years of his journey as a teacher and Head Teacher Shri Santhosh Kumar Bhedodkar Mandal has been dedicated to creating innovative and effective teaching methodologies by integratingarts like singing, music along with ICT in teaching learning process, which resulted in improved learning outcomes and enthusiastic participation of students. Enrolment in his school increased every year and dropout rates reduced due to his efforts. He has served as a State ResourcePerson and imparted training to teachers on different ICT tools, Pedagogy of SocialSciences etc. He has also actively participated in the development of textbooks, worksheets by SCERT, Telangana Open School Society. He initiated programmes like Namaste Nipani where students gather online after school hours and read online newspaper, magazines, story books and share their knowledge.
core: Use of technology for learning

name: Ms. Ritika Anand
school: ST. MARKS SEC SEC PUBLIC SCHOOL, PASCHIM VIHAR, A-BLOCK MEERA BAGH, WEST DELHI DELHI - 110087
citation: With 22 years of experience in teaching administration, and management of school activities at St Marks SchoolNew Delhi, Ms. Ritika Anand has strived to build a creative, innovative safe and healthy environmentat school. She collaborates with specialeducation teachers and guidance counsellors to help in implementing special education, mental health and counselling programs.She has contributed to Kishore Manch, NCERT PM e-vidya, DIKSHA portal,SWAYAMPRABHA, NIOS Mukt Vidya Vani as a subject expert in Physics.She has created infographics, scripts, toys games, story boards etc for children. At present he is the Lead City Coordinator CBSE of 4 districts of UP and also looking after the smooth functioning of Board Examination as City Coordinator CBSE Meerut District.
core: Governance

school: GOVERNMENT BOYS HR SEC SCHOOL, ALANGANALLUR, MADURAI TAMIL NADU - 625501

Furthermore,he is shaping the habits and attitudes of young learners. He has understood the transformative power of physical education in nurturing holistic development and is conveying the same to students.
core: Innovative pedagogy and joyful learning

core: Innovative pedagogy and joyful learning

name: Ms. Mrinal Nandkishor Ganjale
school: Z P SCHOOL PIMPALGAON TARFE MAHALUNGE, AMBEGAON, PUNE MAHARASHTRA - 410503
citation: Ms. Mrinal Nandkishor Ganjale uses modern technology in teaching and tries to impart life-oriented education to students. core: Use of technology for learning

name: Mr. Amit Kumar
citation: Mr. Amit Kumar, a computer teacher at Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya at Theog, Shimla, of Himachal Pradesh has made science and math learning a great fun to students. Adopting a blended learning approach to put his computers education to the best use, Mr. Amit has used Free and Open Source Software (FOSS) based MOOCs to reach out to students in the same class but with different abilities to learn. By introducing Collaborative Flipped learning in the classroom to implement Communication, Critical Thinking, Creativity, Curation and Collaboration to empower students and teachers with 21st Century skills he made the science leaning an all-round experience to students. For students with rural backdrop, Mr. Amit’s innovative approaches such as Creation of Mind Maps by students, Skype Interactions of students with classrooms across various countries, collaborative learning using Wakelet and student voice empowerment for better engagement using Flipgrid are plane changing experiences. It helped his students to participate in various National and International level competitions like NSF, ENF, Inspire Manak Award, e-Raksha Competition and Adobe Creativity Challenge with accolades. In an effort to extend his efforts to others, Mr. Amit has published Books and more than 75 research papers. By giving the experience of a fully loaded corporate school at a Navodaya school, Mr. Amit proves to be a ‘super teacher’ for his students.

name: Ms. Anju Dahiya
school: Government Sr. Sec. School, Barwasni, Sonipat
citation: Ms. Anju Dahiya is an immensely talented Science (Chemistry) teacher. She has designed innovative methods for kindling the curiosity of students so that knowledge is not only disseminated but created as well. The science congresses, conclaves, quizzes have been effectively employed. In order to develop personalities of the students in a holistic manner, she has initiated many activities such as mountaineering, planting of trees and the use of QR codes for getting detailed information needed. Ms. Anju took the help of NGOs and philanthropists for updating the infrastructure of the school.

name: Mr. Aravindaraja D
citation: Mr. Aravindaraja D. is model for what can be achieved with hard work and commitment. He has put his small school on the international map by the innovative programmes. The bubble show, creation of the science corner to stimulate curiosity, the eco club, use of Foldscope project microscopy, establishing photography centre are all noteworthy. Special mention must be made about the students who won International Astronomical Union award from among 128 countries, Honorary Mention award in Worldwide Crystal growing competition, winning prizes in Make Science International competition at Paris, receiving recognition certificate from Vigyan Prasar, Government of India. His mastery over rangoli art and drawing have made his classrooms and teaching exciting. His love of science has excited and involved the entire community.

name: Mr. Arun Kumar Garg
citation: Mr. Arun Kumar Garg heads the school. His contributions in making the school more learners friendly made headlines. The concepts that he introduced such as kitchen gardening, subject labs and education village have made the students practice sustainable lifestyles. Being a mathematics teacher he innovated with pedagogy to make mathematics learning more joyful. He went on to do online teaching and organized doubts clearing sessions that spreads across school boundaries. Innovative practices such as making the students write review of books that they study in a well-developed school library helps the students in overall development and improves their creative thinking. He has been maintaining a good balance of school development and teaching and that has earned him laurels.

name: Mr. Buddhadev Dutta
addr: Joypur Primary School, Bankura, West Bengal - 722138
citation: Mr.Buddhadev Datta, a primary school teacher at Joypur Primary School in West Bengal is an exemplary innovator in school education. Notwithstanding the rural setting of his school he went on to innovate pedagogical methods that gets the students interested and involved. Breaking the monotony, he made the students ask questions and he as a teacher answered them and this has helped immensely in inculcating critical thinking in students. Peer to peer learning process which is an advanced pedagogical method implemented in foreign countries is followed by this ‘dedicated and innovative guru’ in West Bengal. Creating a reading club he also tried to get the students a habit of reading. Coming from vulnerable conditions geographically, he ensured that his students are equipped with lifesaving skills. His efforts during COVID pandemic where he created e-content and innovative online material to help students continue their learning and attending to the learning gaps as they return to physical school demonstrates his love to students and sincerity as a teacher. He promises to make big roads to his students and for their bright future.

name: Mr. Durga Ram Muwal
citation: Mr. Durga Ram Muwal has shown himself to be dedicated and motivated teacher who has worked very hard for the improvement and performance of his school. The school caters to the most deprived sections of the society. He has worked hard to make the school attractive and effective. His abilities and effectiveness in yoga training, self-defence training have given him a popular face among the community. He has been successfully curtailing dropouts by activating the interest of students through the use of joyful TLMs and experiential pedagogical practices and co-scholastic activities. He has given a voice to the girl child through education.

name: Ms. G. Ponsankari
citation: Ms. G. Ponsankari has done most of what is expected of a complete teacher. Joining hands with NGOs to build eco-friendly components for the school, developing local health traditions, plastic free campus, effective Alumni meets, project-based learning, optimising the use of Atal Tinkering Lab and ensuring peer learning in the school have all been her fingerprints on the school canvas. Niti Ayog’s award is a reward for her good work. Her out of classroom activities are a revelation of her acumen.

name: Ms. Gamchi Timre R. Marak
citation: Ms. Gamchi Timre R Marak is a courageous lady determined to do her best for the rural, inaccessible areas and help children to discover their potentials. Having worked as an administrator in a school, she noticed the challenges faced by the children in the mining areas and decided to start a school of her own with the local support and a few similar minded teachers. She took to counselling, introducing innovative teaching programmes so that these children could be drawn out of the rampant alcoholism, domestic violence and early marriages. She introduced Music and Taekwondo and agriculture to hold back these children. Her visits to the homes of parents have ironed out a few challenges and the NLP sessions have offered succour to the troubled minds.

name: Mr. Harpreet Singh
citation: Mr. Harpreet Singh, as a head teacher of Government Primary Smart School, has demonstrated committed efforts in transforming his school infrastructure by mobilizing support from NRIs and the community apart from his own personal contributions. He not only made the school clean, hygienic and modern, but also ensured that the learning is joyful for students by establishing Special Education Activity Park, various labs for languages as well as science and social science subject areas. Not limiting to his own school, he mentored 5 other schools in Punjab to become clean and smart in providing education. Making his school as ISO certified school, he has been inspiring many other schools in Punjab to modernize their school infrastructure and student learning.

name: Mr. Iswar Chandra Nayak
citation: Mr. Iswar Chandra Nayak is an Assistant Teacher at Government Upper Primary School Kanapur in Odisha. He is an extensive writer and a popular columnist in the field of school education. He has implemented innovation in teaching methods such as ‘devise the education material and means of delivery by observing the students’. He not only published these innovative practices in the form of books, columns and magazines but also made the students part of such writings. With his writings and interaction on various platforms he has reached out to larger audience making the impact manifolds and that has given him wide recognition and many accolades at state and national level. With the combination of dedicated teaching, innovation in pedagogy and extensive writing and outreach Mr. Nayak can motivate and be role model for many young teachers in the country.

name: Ms. Jainus Jacob
citation: Ms. Jainus Jacob has demonstrated what academic acumen and hard work can do to a teacher and to the students through her. Her committed efforts for the last 26 years have been a story of struggle, experimentation and inevitable success. The recognition has come in the form of KVS National innovation and experimentation award, Fulbright Distinguished award for teachers and publication of the coffee table book by Intel. Her videos and projects have attracted the attention of scholars in education.

name: Mr. Kandala Ramaiah
citation: Mr. Kandala Ramaiah is a teacher at Zilla Parishad High School at Abbapur in Telangana State. He used the local conditions to innovate in teaching mathematics. Math Rangoli to teach shapes and Algebraic tiling on the floor and wall painting with math concepts goes well with the local and limiting conditions of a government school with very good outcomes. Use of simple graph paper to teach the basic math concepts testimonies his ‘presence of mind’ in innovating to the local conditions. The ‘connected learning’ adopted by Mr. Kandala during COVID is a praise worthy initiative to ensure learning during the pandemic. This enthusiastic teacher has used social media based crowd funding approach to improve his school infrastructure. He rephrased the government’s slogan ‘mana vuru, mana badi’ as ‘mana vuru, mana badi, mana gudi’ (translates to ‘our village, our school, our temple’) and that demonstrates his sincerity as a teacher. Mr. Kandala’s innovation and application would go a long way in serving the students.

name: Mr. Kaustubh Chandra Joshi
citation: Mr. Kaustubh Chandra Joshi, exemplifies school leadership skills as a Principal of a higher secondary school. As a result of his ability and a range of diverse learning experiences, he has contributed a lot for the holistic development of the students. He has contributed in creation of virtual lab as well as a website to promote ICT based learning. He has developed innovative digital library and computer club in his school and is extensively using the same for students learning. His efforts have led students to succeed and achieve positions in many prestigious fields. His dedication and leadership skill in school and building a well-rounded perspective for his students make him an exemplary teacher.

name: Ms. Kavita Sanghvi
citation: Believing in holistic and society sensitive growth of children, Ms. Kavita Sanghvi, the Principal of the school, has made efforts in devising the curriculum that gives the students a chance to explore many domains of learning. ‘Bag less day’ initiative that she had implemented helped the students to try and experiment with different fields including arts and culture and this is the closest to the philosophy adopted in the New Education Policy (NEP 2020). The blend of science excellence which allowed the students to participate in ISRO activities and the focused activity on life skills where they are taught soap and shoe making etc. is an example of a balance in curriculum that many schools may like to follow. Ms. Kavita has been a STEM educator, resource person to all major education bodies in the country and as an educator and school administrator her outreach has been phenomenal wherein she trained teachers in countries like Maldives and Nepal. Ms. Kavita sets an example of a perfect school administrator for ‘urban setting’.

name: Mr. Khursheed Ahmad
citation: Mr. Khursheed Ahmad is a science teacher at Composite School, Sahawa in Uttar Pradesh. Popularizing science by impactful teaching is the heart of Mr. Ahmad’s teaching philosophy. Simple innovations in pedagogy such as using the elements of periodic table as role numbers of students to make it easy for them to remember is simple but proved to be effective. With the limited resources he made science models such as heart, human circulatory system etc. with recycled material and made students do experiments such as chromatography. Enthused by this learning the students got various national scholarships such as INSPIRE and prizes in science competitions. His efforts and ability to handhold the students towards scientific temperament goes a long way with the national ambitions of Atmanirbhar Bharat.

name: Ms. Mala Jigdal Dorjee
citation: Ms. Mala Jigdal Dorjee started with the determination of making the Government school touch the highest standards in education. She did everything possible to get the infrastructure to an acceptable level, by seeking donations, conducting charity shows, reaching out to CSR funds. She got training for her teachers in creative teaching strategies, took the issue of tackling the substance abuse seriously, established Artificial Intelligence laboratory, launched the Entrepreneurship club, celebrated the Annual Day in a grand manner and instituted cash prizes for grade X and XII toppers. All these measures have changed the mindset of parents towards the Government School.

name: Ms. Mamta Ahar
citation: Ms. Mamta Ahar, an assistant teacher of a government primary school has shown keen interest and practice in creating a joyful environment. She has been able to mobilize community support for enhancing enrolment among girls in a rural location. She has taken special care to encourage children in different national integration activities. She believes in including the spirit of lifelong learning with use of innovative teaching learning practices through dedicated reading corners, use of technology, music in education and encouraging participation in sports. She has also implemented home counselling and her deeper involvement and encouragement in the school helped students’ holistic development.

name: Ms. Maria Murena Miranda
citation: With her unflinching efforts, Ms. Maria Murena Miranda as Principal has successfully renovated, upgraded and made her rural tribal school infrastructure child friendly with the help of the community. Due to her efforts, dropout rate has declined in her school. She has worked hard to support tribal students by undertaking home visits, remedial classes, encouraging girls by providing free note books and uniforms. She inspires her students with good values and helps them in building a strong foundation for their lives ahead.

name: Ms. Meenakshi Goswami
citation: As a Principal, Ms. Meenakshi Goswami is able to establish a positive school culture by treating the people the way they would like to be treated. She has helped guiding the curriculum development with the teachers providing insight and leadership to meet both students and teachers needs. She lays emphasis on the usages of language and removes fear for learning the language. She shares warm personal interactions for their academic progress. She has concentrated on social skill development and overall personality development along with acquisition of knowledge of the child.

name: Ms. Mimi Yhoshii
citation: Ms. Mimi Yhoshii is a graduate teacher and also the head teacher, who has motivation built in her. Her incorrigible enthusiasm, rubbed off on the community and that resulted in building extra classrooms, beautifying the campus, school meal programme, develop a kitchen garden and that lead to the inevitable increase in the enrolment. 80% of her students are domestic helpers and hence, she conducts classes for them after school hours to reduce drop-out rate. Particularly fascinating are her innovative teaching learning methods and helping children to learn vocations. Turning bio non -degradable plastic waste into baskets, floor mats, old clothes into potholders, door mats and selling them to generate some income for the school are wonderful ideas of Ms. Mimi.

name: Mr. Mohd. Jabir
citation: Mr. Mohd Jabir is a senior educator in English and Environmental Studies at Government Middle School Karith, Ladakh. Mr. Jabir finds innovative ways to teach which are based on the principle of ‘no punishment to students’. Acting smartly as per children’s psychology, he used the technique of ‘clapping while learning’ for teaching English Phonetics, Grammar, Vocabulary and many others. Taking ‘joyful learning’ as his philosophy he tried innovative ways of teaching such as Prose Singing Strategy, Learning with Body Language, Teaching via Slogan Technique, Language Games, Teaching in Open Air, Story Role Playing etc. He has been training teachers of the other schools on these innovations and also published the same in research journals. His efforts during COVID pandemic by innovating with the concepts of WhatsApp Classroom, Offline Notes and Online Assessments etc. to avoid ‘student disconnect’ are the testimony of his sincerity as a teacher.

name: Mr. Neeraj Saxena
citation: Mr. Neeraj Saxena is an iconic teacher, social reformer, determined soldier, all rolled in one. His school is situated in the forest area and he is the only teacher in the school. He contacted everyone willing to listen, to uplift the facilities for the school. From getting the road to the school, borewell and garden, Mr. Neeraj has motivated and mobilised the women in the villages around, to be perfect volunteers for schoolwork. The whole village is charged up with his motivation. He has convinced the parents to send girls to school and there are 54 of them already.

name: Ms. Nishi Kumari
citation: Ms. Nishi Kumari as a teacher of the Mahadev Higher Secondary School has shown herself to be an extremely holistic and versatile teacher. A state level active career counsellor, she has been involved in programs such as awareness about child rights, child marriage, dowry, menstrual hygiene, creating pollution free environment, waste management etc. in collaboration with other organizations. She has motivated students to think rationally, implemented learner centered pedagogy in classrooms, and created a culture of creativity and innovation. She has also contributed in preparing e-content, models, and learning resources for which she was selected from the state for National Teacher Resource Repository (NTRR). She has been engaged consistently with the community to increase enrolment and to reduce dropout rate particularly for girls.

name: Mr. Pradeep Negi
citation: Mr. Pradeep Negi is a Lecturer and passionate about providing equal educational opportunities to the underprivileged children. He has made enormous effort for mobilization of society through different awareness programmes, educational visits of students and organized environmental programmes. He has promoted innovative experiments for joyful learning like use of ICT, Blogs and Websites, YouTube channels, TLM, Project based learning, activity orientation and role play method. His creative thinking inspires many and creates a climate for innovation in his school.

name: Mr. Nongmaithem Gautam Singh
citation: Mr. Nongmaithem Gautam Singh, a primary teacher at the Eastern Ideal High School in Manipur has been striving to provide better instruction to his students within the limited pool of resources. His attempt to protect students from the falling chalk powder by converting the blackboards to white boards using the local material is praise worthy. Mr. Singh has put the local resources such as bamboo to their best use with his innovative thinking in making protractors, bulletin boards out of bamboo. He donated and also trained other school teachers in doing so. All his innovations did not limit to curriculum and instruction but extended to augment the school infrastructure. Ideas such as ‘volunteer painting’, ‘crowd funding’ and ‘renovation with old clothes’ were not only put to use in his school but also propagated to the other schools. Use of waste material in making teaching aids and his zeal to provide students with a better instruction not only is praise worthy but also inspiring to others.

name: Mr. Om Prakash Patidar
citation: Mr. Om Prakash Patidar has shown himself to be a dedicated and motivated teacher of senior secondary school who has worked very hard for the improvement and performance of his school. He has implemented many innovative practices for making the learning joyful through development of e-content and ICT tools for encouraging creativity in science teaching and learning. He has worked on online laboratory students for laboratory experiences. He has untiringly built a strong rapport with the community and has thus helped the school to attain high enrolment. His creative thinking inspires many and creates a climate of innovation in his school.

name: Ms. Rajni Sharma
citation: Ms Rajni Sharma is a dedicated teacher in a primary school who has done innovative work to reach out to students to support their education during the pandemic time as well as the normal time. She has developed interesting online materials for use in virtual classes, of which most are self-developed materials including balgeet. She has been playing the role of a mentor too for teachers. She has also contributed her efforts for environmental awareness. Her innovative way for integrated learning across subjects has been widely disseminated and appreciated.

name: Mr. Ramachandran K
citation: Mr. Ramachandran K. is primary teacher who is committed to make a difference to the lives of not only his students but also to the community he serves. It is gratifying to see the entire community involved in building and developing a government school and Mr. Ramachandran is the focal point. Beginning from clearing the land from the noxious Karuvelam trees to planting flower and fruit plants, installing drip irrigation, painting the building, getting books and stationery all with public support has been a great saga of tenacity and perseverance. Motivating all the teachers for creative teaching with worksheets and activities, introducing Thirukkural for all the students and conducting competitions is a new dimension of spirituality in education.

name: Dr. Ravi Aruna
citation: Dr. Ravi Aruna is a Physical Science teacher at ASNRA Zilla Prishad High School in Kanuru of Andhra Pradesh. Her attempt to make science learning more effective by employing the ‘Immerse learning’ technique proved to imbibe science temperament in students who went on to win many prizes in science exhibitions. She employed low cost TLM such as clay moldings to explain science concepts and resorted to drama and play to make science learning joyful. Raising funds with the community involvement she has also helped in improving the school infrastructure. Putting to use her PhD research experience, Dr. Aruna has developed an innovative teaching model named ‘Group Clinical Supervision Model’ for the evaluation of the professional development of the in-service teachers. She has participated actively in outreach and as resource person at a number of prestigious programmes such as NISHTHA and published handbooks on physical science teachers for SCERT.

name: Mr. Santosh Nath
citation: Mr. Santosh Nath is a man on a mission to popularise science and fight superstitions. His work is exemplary in the sense that his ICT classroom was converted into the COVID war room and entire South Tripura was monitored through it. His working models and exhibits have made his school a place of visit. Experiments to calculate the rate of photosynthesis in different coloured lights, demonstration of Newton’s laws, mobile globe, structure of DNA, models to interpret geometrical shapes, colours of light have attracted the children and public and the reason for increased admissions to the school. His dramas, role plays are the tools to warn people against superstitions. With public support, he has built clean hygienic toilets with incinerators. His effective teaching methods coupled with social interactions have made him a Man Friday for the community.

name: Mr. Saurabh Suman
school: Lalit Narayan Laxmi Narayan Project Girls High School
citation: Mr. Saurabh Suman, teacher of Lalit Narayan Laxmi Narayan Project Girls High School has put immense effort to improve the pedagogic and academic aspects of his School. He has developed e-content for Science and Mathematics and these are very useful for students and teachers. For introducing modern techniques in his school, he has done many innovations such as smart card for social distancing, smart blind stick, RADAR, automatic security road system, SMS alert flood control system, voice controlled electronic appliance and smart dustbin. He has also given importance to coding and robotics to enable students for creating different models as a support to their other activities. For bringing social awareness he has done so many things through his paintings and creativity. Programmes such as stop the alcohol, voters’ awareness, stop dowry, use of dustbin, yoga, planting sapling have helped to bring awareness among students and community.

name: Ms. Seema Rani
citation: As a Principal, Ms. Seema Rani has been involved in providing holistic education for making global citizens out of her students. She is a dynamic administrator known for her community and social outreach programs. She has taken lead for both character building and nation building via establishing honesty shop, Bachpan ki Galiband and many more such innovations in her school. She has promoted awareness about reducing the use of polythene bags, conversion of dry leaves into organic compost, dual mode of teaching, liquid soap and hand sanitizer preparation in her school. She has empowered teacher educators for inclusive education too. Her motto is not only to impart knowledge to the students but also to inculcate in them wisdom, compassion and humanitarian spirit.

name: Mr. Shashikant Sambhajirao Kulthe
citation: Mr. Shashikant Sambhajirao Kulthe has been a pioneer in educating children of migrants. His school is located in a remote area, mostly inhabited by Banjaras whose main vocation is to cut sugar cane crop. They would go away to different places for work along with their children, who would miss schooling. Mr. Kulthe has ensured that the children stay in the village and get educated. He has an interesting academic profile with degrees in English, Hindi, Urdu and Music, which he uses to the maximum to help his students to learn. The community support he has received in building infrastructure, stay facilities for children is creditable. Employing audio visual aids, conducting various activities and competitions and writing articles and books make Mr. Kulthe a model teacher.

name: Ms. Shipra
school: Tata Workers Union High School Kadma
citation: Ms. Shipra is an extremely creative teacher of science in a high school. She has introduced many innovative practices in teaching of science that have helped students to learn better. She has guided the metamorphosis of school from a deprived school to better accomplished school. She works with 360 degree approach for holistic development of students in her school. She is committed to inspire students to learn through participation, collaboration and experimentation utilizing new techniques and natural resources for improving our society and environment as well as to build cost effective solutions.

name: Mr. Sidharth Yonzone
citation: Mr. Sidharth Yonzone is an example of a creative teacher, who can materialise something very useful from almost nothing. When he became the founder Principal of the Ekalavya Model Residential School at Gangyap, Sikkim, there was no infrastructure. From building the infrastructure, bringing children out of their natural shyness to building confidence and Values in them using the unique way of basketball and music have been success stories recognised internationally. His journey on the road less travelled is actually a guiding light for a creative teacher.

name: Mr. Somnath Waman Walke
citation: Mr. Somnath Waman Walke is an amazing talent dedicated to build a school of excellence, where novelty is a rule. Convincing the migratory parents to stay back for their children’s education, arranging School meals, getting community support to make the school tech savvy with tablets for children, creating an audio visual studio, making children sing the poems in the text book and converting the lessons in to recorded role plays, planning on line classes when the only road that connects the village to the school gets inundated during rainy days, painting the school building with his own resources have made this school a Happy school. Creative activities like Saturday – my war, backpack free day, let’s enjoy, my mirror have been attractions and have resulted in better enrolment. Introducing Robotics is an addition to long list of achievements.

name: Ms. Sunita
citation: Ms. Sunita is a science teacher of special education for the deaf students and works passionately to inculcate scientific and innovative spirit amongst her deaf students. She has demonstrated that she is a creative and innovative teacher who has kept her students engaged in learning activities in challenging circumstances. She has set up a science lab for children with special needs. She has extended support to her students through the creation of online teacher module, innovative e-videos, and workbooks for class. Her skills have contributed to a larger audience as she was a resource person for the training of teachers.

name: Ms. Sunitha Rao
citation: Ms. Sunita Rao is the Principal at Delhi Public School (DPS) in Nacharam of Telangana State. Over her long and illustrious career as an educator she has served different schools in various capacities. At DPS she was instrumental in establishing ‘Toy Lab’ as part of joyful and art based learning for the young learners. Her efforts in getting the e-content developed for the pre-school children are a great value addition. Ms. Sunita has focused more on developing lab such as Artificial Intelligence lab which provided the dynamic urban students a chance to express themselves. As a social responsibility Ms. Sunita’s initiative to share her resources with the local government schools is noteworthy and sets an example for others. ‘Each one – Teach one’ initiative that aims to help the staff within her school is an excellent ‘extension’ service that is worth for every school to attempt.

name: Mr. T N Sridhar
citation: Mr. T N Sridhar from ZillaParishad School in Telangana State is an educator who believed strongly in experiential and thought provocative learning both for students and teachers. Some of the innovative programmes that he adopted such as Vidhyabarthi, kutuhal, vacation value and establishment of ‘Kalam Dream Force’ by donating his salary demonstrate his vision and drive for such approach to learning. Use of low cost material to develop concept labs with a large number of demonstrative material and self-learning kits showcases his attempt to beat the ‘funds limitation’ in achieving his objective in teaching. Joyful learning with ‘self-collected material’ by students is the closest to the new ways of teaching under the new NEP. Mr. Sridhar’s efforts have resulted in his students winning scholarships such as NCSC, INSPIRE, India International Science Festivals and recognition in international programmes such as SAKURA Japan science exchange program. His statement that village students are high on ‘innovation’ quotient compared to ‘criticality’ quotient portrays his deep understanding of the students with rural backdrop.

name: Mr. Umesh Bharatbhai Vala
citation: Mr. Umesh Bharatbhai Vala is a remarkable teacher and is a combination of many things that makes an ideal teacher – punctuality, hard work, care and a huge commitment for social work. He is a panelist for SCERT and NCERT in the Social Science and Gujarati subjects. In Gujarati, that he teaches, the results in the Board examinations, for the last three years are cent percent.
