He conducts regular camps for rural children. His outstanding social commitment is seen in the way he helps slum & street children get education at their own place. To top it all, he has not taken a single day leave for the last seven years.

name: Mr Umesh T P
citation: Mr. Umesh T P has innovatively deployed effective teaching strategies to improve his school which is in the interior village, deprived of basic facilities. Keeping aside all the challenges while performing the duty, he has contributed to reduce high dropout rates. He has taken proactive measures not only to create an attractive school but also to introduce many pedagogical practices to maximize learning levels of his students. He has successfully mobilized the community for improving student-enrolment, school infrastructure and setting up of smart classrooms. He has contributed to the development of e-content and use of ICT for improving teaching learning of students.

name: Ms. Vandna Shahi
citation: Ms. Vandana Shahi, the Principal of BCM School, Ludhiana in Punjab believes strongly in giving freedom to her students to explore their inherent strengths. She provides them with all kinds of labs wherein they can explore their interest. Ideas factory, innovation lab and LAKSHAY initiative are such efforts which are deeply admired by students and closely aligned to the aspirations of NEP 2020. Her efforts to develop leadership qualities in students by establishing entrepreneurs’ lab fit perfectly with the present trend and needs of urban students. All such efforts have resulted in students excelling in all domains of art and science and this can be an example of providing exploratory curriculum in school education. She has demonstrated great social responsibility and imbibing the same in students by some initiatives such as WE CARE under which women empowerment activities were conducted. Ms. Vandana sets an example of a model urban school that allows the aspirations of the students to flourish.

name: Mr. Virender Kumar
citation: Mr. Virender Kumar is a trained graduate teacher who is passionate in employing art as an instrument of social change. He has authored three books and has trained over 20,000 teachers on the aspect of art integration in curriculum. He has taken up the mission of improving the handwriting of students by teaching them calligraphy. He also teaches English and Social Science subjects. He has served as the resource person for SCERT, NCERT and NIEPA.

name: Mr. Yudhveer
citation: Mr. Yudhveer has played multiple roles depending on the need of the school as a teacher in Hindi, English, Mathematics, Computer Science, EVS, Yoga and General Knowledge. That speaks of his versatility. Mr. Yudhveer has functioned as State Nodal Resource Person for online content development for Har Ghar Pathashala official web portal, Computer and ICT Coordinator of school, Member of Focus Groups of the state on NEP 2020.

name: Mr. Ranjan Kumar Biswas
citation: Mr. Ranjan Kumar Biswas, as a teacher has done commendable work in making the learning easier for children with visual challenge. He has taught them through Braille script, Abacus for Mathematics and imparted vocational training for life skills development. He has developed videos on how to use Abacus, Braille script, signature guide, tactile sketch maker, sign language for children with cerebral palsy, paddle wheeler and rollator. His innovations such as tactile sketch maker and signature guide has given him a unique identification. His innovative work for inclusive education to help differently abled learners has helped them to learn better and improved enrolment in the school.

name: Ms. Mamta Paliwal
citation: Ms. Mamta Paliwal is a very dedicated maths teacher who has made learning maths joyful and interesting for girls at her school. She teaches maths with games, quizzes, online apps and 3D models with innovative materials along with work at the Atal Tinkering Lab, all of which has contributed towards higher student motivation and improved learning outcomes. During the pandemic, she created her own maths tutorials on a YouTube channel that was also telecast on Edusat and other media. She is also actively engaged in extra-curricular cultural and social activities, campus improvement and collection drives of materials for students.

name: Shri Kamal Kishore Sharma
school: Government Senior Secondary School Kalhog, Kandaghat
citation: Shri Kamal Kishore Sharma, exemplifies school leadership skills as a Principal of a Govt. Senior Secondary School. As a result of his ability to work with various stakeholders he could get much needed land donated for the school in order to create good school infrastructure. His dedication and positive attitude resulted in the mobilization of adequate funds for the development of the land and construction of better and safer infrastructure for the school including a refurbished Mid Day Meal Room and improved classrooms. He also mobilized the local community to offer its services in many forms including Shramdaan so as to optimally use all available resources for setting up a school with good standards.

name: Shri Jagtar Singh
citation: Mr. Jagtar Singh as a primary school teacher mobilised the community to set up very good infrastructure for his school. He mobilised funds to improve the school in terms of well-maintained and colourful classrooms, optimum use of walls and outdoor spaces as teaching learning aids, enhancing digital infrastructure of his own school by providing projectors, e-content, e-libraries, and language labs. He introduced innovative ideas for reading and learning during the pandemic by extensive use of e-materials as also providing smart phones to students and teachers.

name: Shri Vipin Kumar
school: Rajkiya Pratibha Vikas Vidyalaya, Sector-11 Rohini
citation: Shri Vipin Kumar as Vice Principal of Rajkiya Pratibha Vikas Vidyalaya, Sector-11, Rohini in North West Delhi District has worked consistently and spearheaded the school towards excellence which has shown steady outcomes in the number of students from his school successfully completing and qualifying in national competitions like the NEET exam, JEE exam, NMMS exam etc. He has also encouraged and guided students to participate and win positions in other competitions for excellence in Science, the Olympiads of different subjects and in the field of sports. He has strived towards making his school a centre for excellence and high achievement, with his leadership skills and dedication to his students.

name: Shri Deepak Joshi
school: Govt. Sr. Sec. School, Dandusar, Bikaner
citation: Shri Deepak Joshi is a Science Teacher and works passionately to inculcate scientific and innovative spirit amongst his students. He has developed an innovative science lab in his school, which is used by his students to work on new ideas. As a result, about 10 students under his charge, have won the prestigious ‘Inspire Award’ at the national level. He has also worked tirelessly to connect science to address local issues of nutrition with plants rich in vitamins, a harness to carry cement bags etc. so as to help children and the community appreciate and develop a scientific temper.

name: Shri Jai Singh
school: Govt. Ser. Sec. School, Devroad, Surajgarh, Jhunjhunu
citation: Shri Jai Singh is a Sports Teacher and has been instrumental in constructing a big sport’s stadium for games like volleyball, football, basketball, an athlete track etc. in his school. He accomplished this goal by raising funds from various government schemes and by extensive community mobilisation. He is very passionate about Yoga and sports and has been working tirelessly for promoting physical fitness amongst youngsters, for several decades. He has trained and inspired multiple players amongst which there are several girls, to compete nationally and beyond, in a variety of games.

name: Ms Vanita Dayabhai Rathod
school: Shri Vinoba Bhave School No 93, Nana Mava, West Zone Rajkot
citation: Ms. Vanita Rathod is a committed and proud Principal of an upper primary school. She has systematically built up an attractive and sound school infrastructure which has attracted and enhanced enrolments over the years. She has tirelessly built a theme for protection of the environment in her school by enthusing students towards systematic plantation drives, planting and maintenance of a medicinal garden etc. Her aim has been to educate students on sustainability by reuse of waste materials in aesthetic ways so as to beautify the school campus.

name: Shri Ashok Kumar Mohanlal Parmar
citation: Mr. Ashok kumar Mohanlal Parmar is very creative educator with several innovative toys, games and puzzles to his credit. He has been actively involved in creating e-content on Science concepts on social media. He reaches out to students through his YouTube channel and WhatsApp groups where he shares logical puzzles and promotes STEM learning. His innovative models and practices for integrated learning across subjects, have been widely disseminated and appreciated.

name: Shri Shakti Patel
school: Govt. High School, Mand, Bichhiya, Mandla
citation: Shri Shakti Patel is a dedicated teacher of Hindi in a government High School who has done innovative work to reach out to his students to support their education during the pandemic times. He developed interesting online materials for use in virtual classes, of which over one hundred were self-study materials for students and also several training videos for teachers. His skills have contributed to a larger audience as he was a resource person for the training of teachers with many online teacher training programmes being conducted in the State. He continued to assist his students with follow up studies online and where necessary, with physical materials being made available to them.

name: Shri Haridas Sharma
citation: As a Head Teacher of Upper Primary School, Shri Hari Das Sharma’s devotion to the profession and his school leadership abilities have been visible in his tireless efforts to change the face of his school. He mobilized the students, fellow teachers, and the larger community to work together, donate time and resources to provide a clean safe and hygienic learning environment. Infrastructural improvements like creation of the boundary, several smart classrooms, use of walls as learning aids and a medicinal garden were accomplished, despite scarcity of resources. His desire to make the school as a place for all around development led to enhanced academic and co-curricular achievements amongst the children.

name: Ms Chandana Dutta
school: M.S. Ranti Government School, Rajnagar, Madhubani
citation: Ms. Chandana Dutta has displayed strong resolve and community mobilization skills to create an inspired and equitable learning environment in her school, despite working within a socially challenging environment and large resource constraints. Her focus on building trust with the community, led to large enrolment of girls from the minority community. She worked with the parents and students to provide basic infrastructural improvements in the school buildings, overcame constraints to girls education and as a language teacher successfully integrated local arts and skills in her teaching methodology.

name: Shri Ashok Kumar Satpathy
citation: Shri Ashok Kumar Satpathy is a Science Teacher and passionate about providing equal educational opportunities to the underprivileged children. As his school suffered from scarcity of resources, he made enormous efforts to connect with school alumni nationally & internationally and systematically motivated them to donate generously for the development of the school. Through these alumni donations, he built up the school infrastructure including a new conference hall, computer labs and procured other ICT equipment for the school. He also instituted several scholarships for meritorious students.

name: Shri Ajit Kumar Sethy
citation: Shri Ajit Kumar Sethy is an arts and music teacher and acting Head Teacher of his school. He has innovated with inter disciplinary learning styles by using his musical instruments as “props” to help children understand abstract concepts in science, mathematics, geography, etc. He also uses this approach to develop problem solving & critical thinking mindset amongst his students. He mobilized the school alumni and the local community to raise funds for the development of his school.

name: Shri Hariswami Das
school: Sovanagar High School, Sovanagar, English Bazar
citation: With his unstinting efforts, Dr. Hariswami Das successfully renovated, upgraded and made his school infrastructure child friendly with the help of the community. Largely due to his efforts, enrolment in his school has gone up manifold and the dropout rate has plummeted. He has designed and implemented several environmental projects with his students so as to create awareness about environmental conservation and sustainable development.

name: Shri Sanjeev Kumar Sharma
school: Government Primary School, Ikhani, Sungal, Pouni, Reasi
citation: Shri Sanjeev Kumar Sharma works as a Teacher in a primary school in a remote and hilly region of J & K where he has made extraordinary efforts to rebuild and improve the poor and dilapidated condition of his school. He has transformed it into a beautiful and attractive school building with the help of the community that he helped mobilize and who have contributed in cash and kind. From very meager enrolments, the school now has very high participation from the village children and this has brought pride and ownership to the local community. Shri Sharma also uses joyful learning and art integrated pedagogy for facilitating learning along with his teacher colleagues.

name: Shri Muhammad Ali
school: Govt Middle School Karith, Shargole, Kargil
citation: Shri Mohammad Ali is an acting Head Teacher in his upper primary school. He is an extremely passionate educator who subscribes to the belief of “learning by doing” which is central to the academic process seen in his classrooms and adopted by his students. Shri Ali has innovated many strategies to improve learning levels, amongst which a notable one is the setting up of ‘subject-wise classrooms’ instead of conventional grade-wise classrooms, thus enabling better focus and facilitating experiential learning.

name: Ms Tripti Mahaur
school: Government Girls Inter College Quila, Sadar, Rampur
citation: Ms.Tripti Mahaur is an inspirational Social Science Educator and has demonstrated that she is a creative and innovative teacher who has kept her students engaged in learning activities, even in challenging circumstances of the pandemic. She has set up a social science lab in her school and engages with the local community to build connections between social science as a subject and social values of humanity, citizenship and social consciousness amongst her students. She believes in education as an empowering tool for girls and guides them to make appropriate choices of subjects with future job prospects and encourages them to continue school beyond class 10.

name: Shri Manish Kumar
school: Junior High School, Shivganj, Sahar, Auraiya
citation: Shri Manish Kumar is a Science Teacher in an Upper Primary school, who has done remarkable work in teaching science beyond books to the students, using real life situations and contexts in meaningful ways and by encouraging participation in experiential projects. He has set up a make shift laboratory where children carry out experiments with waste materials and learn the principles of science by making connections to the practical world around them and learn to innovate and do logical thinking, at the same time.

name: Ms Suruchi Gandhi
school: Bal Bharati Public School, Sector 12, Dwarka
citation: Ms Suruchi Gandhi in her role as a Principal has given her students a range of diverse learning experiences contributing to their holistic development. She has promoted enquiry based learning and skill development through meaningful environmental projects, use of ICT and digital learning, technical work, physical education and community awareness. She has provided an international dimension by including collaboration with different institutions and networks. Through effective leadership, she has also motivated her teachers to become trainers and spread good practices.

name: Ms Achala Verma
school: Birla Balika Vidyapeeth, Pilani, Surajgarh, Jhunjhunun
citation: Ms Achala Verma has done commendable work as a Maths teacher with active pedagogy. She has made learning Maths relevant and enjoyable through a variety of experiential learning activities, integrated learning of maths with sports and the arts. Through interdisciplinary projects, she has made learning Maths contextual, easy and interesting. The importance of Maths in life is further understood by the intervention of alumni students who share how they used Maths in their professions. Her efforts have led students to succeed in many prestigious competitive exams.

name: Shri Mathew K Thomas
citation: Shri Mathew K Thomas, is a Social Science Teacher in a Sainik School, who is dedicated to the aims and objectives of the Sainik School system and has done exemplary work to build his students with strong academic achievements in his subject as well as prepare them with mental and physical robustness for life ahead. As a House Master and a teacher who encourages his students to join the NCC, participate actively in sports especially horse riding, he has contributed to their development as disciplined, agile and healthy students with a spirit for competition and endurance. He has successfully guided students to success in the NDA entrance exams and mentors his wards towards choosing careers in the armed forces.

name: Shri Pramod Kumar Shukla
school: Eklavya Model Residential School, Karpawand, Bastar, Chhattisgarh
citation: Shri Pramod Kumar Shukla is a Lecturer in English in an Eklavya Model residential school in Bastar district of Chattisgarh, who has devotedly worked to improve the scholastic and co-scholastic achievements of tribal students in the school. He has worked tirelessly to enable tribal children develop good capabilities in English by adopting different teaching learning practices that helped the children shake off their fear of speaking in English and helped them to successfully achieve very good results in the class 10 Board examinations. During the pandemic he has extended his support to his students though the development of online and self-study materials. His experience of working with tribal children has led to him becoming a significant resource person for teacher training programmes as well as to guide and support education strategies in tribal regions.

name: Shri Faisal S L
school: Kendriya Vidyalaya Pattom (Shift - I), Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala
citation: Shri Faisal SL has shown himself to be a dedicated and motivated library teacher who has contributed to the promotion of reading through various innovative library activities, has led the digitalisation of library facilities and has trained numerous librarians as a resource person. He has mobilised the Alumni, Parents and community successfully to contribute to the betterment of the school. He has developed some replicable models like virtual library , an audio library , a library on mobile phone and interactive e-books etc.

name: Shri Duda Sora
school: Government Upper Primary, APP Complex, Aalo East, West Siang, Arunachal Pradesh
citation: As a Head Teacher in an Upper Primary school Shri Duda Sora has lead improvement and change in his school by his own example. Working in a remote area, in difficult circumstances and little resources, he has steadfastly built and maintained the school infrastructure in an exemplary manner. He has also added amenities like water supply, smart classrooms, white boards etc. to make the school and its’ pedagogical practices interesting to the students. With special focus on good health and hygiene habits, with himself as an example, he inspires his students with good values and helps them in building a strong foundation for their lives ahead.

name: Ms. Swedesunuo Zao
citation: Ms Swedesunuo Zao is a dedicated Head Teacher in an upper primary school, who makes meaningful connections with the context of her students’ lives and integrates their academic learning with local traditional activities such as farming, weaving, cultivating organic vegetables for mid-day meals etc. Through this, she has promoted life skills and continuity of local traditions. Through her efforts and community outreach, the school has witnessed higher enrolment, better student attendance and participation all of which has contributed towards a holistic development of her students.

name: Shri Ningmareo Shimray
school: Ukhrul Higher Secondary School, Ukhrul, Manipur
citation: As a Lecturer in Mathematics, Shri Ningmareo Shimray, has shown a keen ability to think out of the box, make inter-disciplinary connections between subjects and come up with novel teaching-learning methodologies. For instance, he has developed techniques for alternate ways of looking at basic operations in mathematics which can be used effectively in writing mathematical tables. He tries to go beyond the confines of his subject and has explored similar techniques for learning of languages and in other subjects. His creative thinking inspires many and creates a climate for innovation in his school.

name: Shri Prem Das Chhetri
school: Sir T N Sr Sec School, Development Area, Gangtok, Sikkim
citation: As a Physics Teacher for Higher Secondary students, Shri Prem Das Chettri, is a dedicated teacher who takes pride in teaching physics in an interesting manner. He has used advanced ICT techniques to teach Physics and helped his school develop capacities in science and innovations by establishing an Atal Tinkering Lab, promoting Robotics etc. which led to an enhanced interest in science among the students and inspired them to participate successfully in many science projects and exhibitions for which they received appreciation and accolades nationally and internationally. Shri Chettri also contributed to devising and implementing a system of online admission of class 11 for all government senior secondary schools of Sikkim for the academic session of 2020-2021.

name: Shri Mingma Sherpa
school: Lum Primary School, Passingdong, North Sikkim, Sikkim
citation: Shri Mingma Sherpa, as a Head Teacher of a Primary school in a remote part of Sikkim, has done remarkable work to raise funds from the community to improve his school’s infrastructure, increase the enrolment of students and retain them in school by improving academic standards and the quality of the mid-day meal. As a good school leader he has demonstrated effective team work with the community and his teachers by introducing many interesting pedagogical practices and experiential activities, which has led to improved learning outcomes amongst the students. With an innovative bent of mind he is bringing many new concepts into the school’s functioning which contributes to the overall improvement of the school and helps build local ownership.

name: Ms Jacinta Vanlalengzami
school: A and M Grandchild School, North Vanlaiphai, East Lungdar, Serchhip, Mizoram
citation: Ms Jacinta Valalengzami is a passionate and highly talented teacher and Headmistress who persevered with community support and corporate assistance to rebuild her school which was unfortunately gutted in a fire. Focusing on revamping and modernizing the school’s infrastructure, she also created a rose garden and a nutrition garden with a zero energy cooling chamber. To make her classroom joyful and exciting for pre-primary children she has created animations and her own nursery rhymes which are also available on YouTube. As a school leader, she has gained the support of her team and respect from her community which is commendable.

name: Shri Sib Sankar Pal
school: Pandabpur High School, Pandabpur, Dukli R.D. Block, West Tripura, Tripura
citation: Shri Sib Shankar Pal as a Head Teacher of a secondary school situated in remote area of the country, has shown great initiative as an able educator and a school administrator. He has mobilized the community to upgrade the infrastructure of his school. He has steadily increased enrolments by reaching out to the families and incentivizing the children. He has been successful in curtailing dropouts by activating the interest of students by using the low cost TLMs for joyful and experiential pedagogical practices and co-scholastic activities.

name: Shri Kangkan Kishor Dutta
school: Bamunpukhuri High School, Bamunpukhuri, East Jorhat Kaliapani, Jorhat, Assam
citation: Shri Kangkan Kishore Dutta is a Maths and general science teacher who works enthusiastically and innovates teaching learning practices so as to help his students improve their scholastic abilities. While using joyful learning methodologies, he has successfully used latest technologies like Virtual Reality and Augmented Reality for developing multiple Teaching Learning Materials like Number Comb model for teaching operations like integers, a low cost Abacus, match stick models to teach geometry etc. His innovative methodologies have created a positive atmosphere for student learning where conceptual understanding is enhanced.

name: Shri Binanda Swargiary
school: K. B. Deulkuchi Higher Secondary School, Deulkuchi, Tamulpur, Baksa, Assam
citation: Shri Binanda Swargiary is a teacher in Bodo literature. He has worked steadily to preserve the Bodo language and its literature while at the same time striving to make it popular, comprehensible and connected to the local culture. To inspire his students, he uses techniques like storytelling, recitation, role plays, singing, art forms which make his teaching interesting and help in understanding the complexities and nuances of the language and its rich literature. He is a prolific writer in the Bodo language and has published books and articles of interest.

name: Shri Manoj Kumar Singh
school: Hindustan Mitra Mandal Middle School, 10 No. Basti Golmuri, Jamshedpur, East Singhbhum, Jharkhand
citation: Shri Manoj Kumar Singh as a teacher of Maths & Science has done innovative work by integrating maths with Art and making challenging mathematical concepts easy and joyful for children of primary and upper primary classes. He uses storytelling, puppetry and toy based pedagogy to teach complex concepts of mathematics. During the pandemic he used digital media to conduct online classes where he demonstrated the use of low cost learning materials. He has actively contributed content on the DIKSHA portal and his publications on Maths teaching have been widely disseminated.

name: Shri Prasad Manapparambil Bhaskaran
citation: Shri Prasad Manapparambil Bhaskaran has done inspirational work as a Head Teacher in a government primary school. His classrooms are colourful, and the learning experiences are joyful, meaningful and contextually relevant. Under his mentorship, young students learn in classrooms and are then exposed to the exciting world of ‘learning by doing’ such as building knowledge about plant life through paddy farming and growing organic vegetables etc. He has even created a bio-diversity park, thus making learning about flora and fauna come alive for his primary students. Sh. Prasad’s complete dedication to his school and building a well-rounded perspective for his students makes him an exemplary school leader.

name: Shri Konathala Phani Bhushan Sridhar
school: Zilla Parishad High School, Lingarajupalem, S Rayavaram, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh
citation: Shri Konathala Phani Bhushan Sridhar, is a Social Science Teacher who has successfully practiced integrated education through experiential learning projects making connections between social science and the learner’s context. As a secondary school teacher, he has encouraged his students to become engaged in providing environmental solutions with traditional techniques such as ground water recharging, vermicomposting, solid waste management as well as inclusion of IC, thus integrating cognitive and life skills. His conviction about environmental education leading to responsible citizenship is a vital contribution to the ethos of his school which deserves recognition.

name: Shri S Muni Reddy
school: Z P High School, M. Paipalli, Irala, Chittoor, Andhra Pradesh
citation: As a High School teacher, Shri S Muni Reddy's passion for Mathematics is visible in his dedication to his students and in his use of innovative pedagogy. He has used innovative techniques outside of the classroom to inspire and help students enjoy Math. He has also developed many hands-on activities to help with conceptual understanding of difficult concepts. His work makes Mathematics come alive. He puts in tireless hours to achieve academic excellence and as a result of his hard work and dedication the results of his students in state level exams has been outstanding. Many of his students have received NMMS scholarships while a sizable number of his students received admissions in prestigious national colleges.

name: Shri Rangaiah Kaderla
school: MPPS Sawarkheda, Kerameri, Kumuram Bheem Asifabad, Telangana
citation: Shri Rangaiah Kaderla is a Headmaster in a primary school who has a passion to make a difference to the lives of children in every aspect. Despite being a single teacher for many years, in rural settings and limited resources, he improved the school’s infrastructure, learning outcomes and worked tirelessly to gain the trust of the parents. As a result, enrollment increased five times. His innovative thinking led to novel initiatives like where almost hundred alumni of the school worked with the students during the lockdown, to help with their online education. His connections with the community also helped in building community awareness against social evils as well as a redoubled faith in education.

name: Shri Ramaswamy Payyavula
school: ZP High School Indiranagar, Siddipet (U), Telangana
citation: As a Head Teacher of a High School Shri Ramaswamy Payyavula has transformed his government school to become one of the most sought after schools in the town. During his tenure he upgraded the school’s infrastructure and introduced many modern facilities, including ICT, plantations, health check-ups, sport and hobby clubs, as a result of which enrollment tripled in his school. He could achieve this by mobilizing the local community and reaching out to NGO’s/ corporates. His focus on quality education led to students getting national scholarships and admission in reputed national colleges.

name: Shri Nagaraja C M
school: Govt High School Doddabanahalli, Bangalore South-04, Karnataka
citation: Shri Nagaraja is a committed Science Teacher who has done commendable work in making the teaching of and doing practical’s of Chemistry and Biology lively and joyful for secondary school students by the introduction of microscale chemistry kits for carrying out multiple learning activities safely and economically. His students have won accolades in national and state level competitions and have achieved academic excellence in learning outcomes. He is an active resource person for his state and has introduced several ICT based innovations in the teaching of Science.

name: Ms Asha Devi K
school: Panchayath Union Middle School, Piratiyur, Manikandam, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu
citation: Ms. Asha Devi is a head teacher who has made sincere efforts in increasing the enrolment in her school almost seven times in a short span of time. She mobilised her team and put in personal resources to publicise and campaign for admissions to her school, by way of using town walls, loud speakers on rickshaws and information dissemination through local TV and cable channels etc. She complemented this by focusing on a range of activities which promote participatory methods through spoken English, ICT, performing arts, sports, introduction of street libraries, extra-curricular activities, attractive classrooms which helped retain students and resulted in greater learning engagement.

name: Ms Lalitha D
school: Government Girls Higher Secondary School, Modakkurichi, Erode, Tamil Nadu
citation: Ms Lalitha D, as a Headmistress of a Government Girls higher secondary school has put in immense effort to improve the pedagogic and academic aspects of her school where amongst other aspects, she has helped establish an Atal Tinkering Lab and invested a large sum of money for innovative infrastructure for scientific experimentation, in order to improve the learning levels of her students. As a Physics teacher she makes her students relate concepts in physics with day to day life, to properly understand applications and usability of the topics as well as uses technology for science, to make leaning easy and accessible. Her students have exhibited exemplary academic and competitive performance both at the State and the National level.

name: Shri Khurshid Kutubuddin Sheikh
school: Z.P. Upper Primary School, Asaralli, Sironcha, Gadchiroli, Maharashtra
citation: Shri Khurshid Kutubuddin Sheikh is a passionate teacher working in a very remote, tribal and Naxalite affected region. He has worked hard to build a school which is child centric and where children feel the excitement of learning. Towards this goal he has been able to create good physical infrastructure with the help of the community, nutritious mid-day meals, ICT enabled teaching learning equipment, a rich school library, an innovative science lab and a creative garden for the study of mathematics and science. Sh. Sheikh also uses different pedagogical techniques for making learning joyful, including use of many small educational films which he has created.

name: Shri Umesh Raghunath Khose
school: Z.P.P.S. Jagdambanagar, Kaddora, Omerga, Osmanabad, Maharashtra
citation: Shri Umesh Raghunath Khose is a primary School Teacher who has worked dedicatedly to improve his school. Located in a backward region, the nomadic communities in the region contributed to very high dropout rates as well as low enrolment of girls. However, Sh. Khose took proactive measures not only to create an attractive school campus but also to introduce many innovative pedagogical practices to maximize learning levels of his students. His outreach with the local community, especially the nomadic labor engaged in sugarcane operations led to a renewed respect from the community which in turn resulted in a big rise in school enrolments and steady retention of students specially girls.

name: Shri Jayasundhar V
school: Government Middle School, Manapet, BRC 2, Puducherry
citation: Shri Jayasundhar V is a Science Teacher who actively encourages his students to work on innovative ideas & projects. He is an innovator himself and has supported his students to work on innovative science projects such as an all in one Wifi antenna, portable organic waste cutting machine, multi-purpose agri drone, instant compost maker etc. As a result he has been able to establish a culture of ideation and innovation in his school. With his encouragement some of his students have been selected for national level Inspire Manak awards.

name: Dr. Shreedevi Devindrappa Kalyan
school: Faculty of Science and Technology, Sharnbasva University, Kalaburagi, Karnataka
citation: Dr. Shreedevi Devindrappa Kalyan is a Faculty of Mathematics at Sharnbasva University, Kalaburagi, Karnataka. She is a Ph.D. in Applied mathematics and a committed academic, researcher and mentor with more than 12 years of service in higher education. Her research expertise covers fluid dynamics, mixed convection, micropolar and nanofluids, and magnetohydrodynamic with papers published in reputed national and international journals. She has also authored books on mathematics and fluid mechanics and successfully guided Ph.D. scholars.

name: Dr. Shobha M E
school: Manipal Institute of Technology, Udupi, Karnataka
citation: Dr. Shobha M E is an Associate Professor of Mathematics at the Manipal Institute of Technology with over 13 years of dedicated service. Dr. Shobha has published many research papers, including Scopus-indexed journals, and has guided Doctoral and Masters theses. Her teaching methodology combines conceptual rigour with real-world applications, enabling students to move beyond rote learning and develop critical thinking and problem-solving skills. She has also contributed significantly to student and community well-being by serving in various capacities and organizing impactful initiatives in health care, environmental awareness and activism.

name: Dr. Anjana Bhatia
school: Hans Raj Mahila Maha Vidyalaya, Jalandhar, Punjab
citation: Dr. Anjana Bhatia is a faculty in the Botany Department at Hans Raj Mahila Maha Vidyalaya, Jalandhar. She blends experiential learning, nature camps and game-based approaches which fosters curiosity and lifelong learning among students. Dr. Bhatia has also conducted impactful research funded by Anusandhan Research Foundation Network (ANRF) and has been instrumental in strengthening science infrastructure in the college under DBT Star College Programme. Her stellar contribution was acknowledged by Department of Biotechnology by inviting her to share her transformative journey as a model for other colleges. Her outreach extends beyond the classroom to NSS, Unnat Bharat Abhiyan, Swachhata missions and women’s empowerment initiatives and effectively bridging academic learning with community engagement.

name: Dr. Debayan Sarkar
citation: Dr. Debayan Sarkar is a Faculty of Chemistry and is also head of the Centre for Rural Development and Technology (CRDT) at Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore). He has developed innovative techniques of teaching Chemistry by employing 3D models and instituting student-village interface for meaningful rural development initiatives. He has developed Visible Light Food storage technology for use by small and marginal farmers. He has also contributed many research papers in national and international journals of repute.

name: Dr. Chandan Sahi
school: Indian Institute of Science Education & Research Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh
citation: Dr. Chandan Sahi is a faculty of Biology with specialization in Stress and Molecular Chaperones in IISER Bhopal. He has re-developed and revised both theory and lab courses in molecular biology and microbiology, with a focus on clarity, engagement and real-world relevance. His teaching approach combines visual tools, interdisciplinary analogies and hands-on modules to support students from varied academic backgrounds. He uses problem-solving tasks, conceptual writing, peer learning and continuous feedback to evaluate deeper understanding and critical thinking. Through these contributions, Dr. Sahi ensures that learning remains inquiry-driven, inter-disciplinary and outcome-oriented, empowering students to become independent thinkers and responsible scientists. He is also an ace researcher with publication in National and International Journals of repute.

name: Prof. Vijayalaxmi J
school: School of Planning and Architecture, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh
citation: She is a Faculty of Architecture in SPA, Vijayawada and specializes in combining research and teaching to advance sustainable design, climate-responsive architecture and smart building materials. Her teaching style is marked by engaging students in problem-solving through real-world "live" projects, utilizing labs for hands-on material testing and passive design modelling, promoting NEPs emphasis on conceptual understanding. She has authored and edited books and created online courses on SWAYAM portal in the domain of ‘Sustainable Architecture’ for college students and industry professionals. She has also contributed in Introductory course on Architecture and Design for school students creating a subtle engagement to promote sustainable built environment.

name: Prof. Sanket Goel
school: Birla Institute of Technology & Sciences, Pilani, Hyderabad Campus, Telangana
citation: Prof. Sanket Goel is an educator and innovator whose teaching and learning pedagogy integrates research, development, innovation and entrepreneurship to create societal impact. At BITS Pilani Hyderabad Campus, he has led multidisciplinary projects in microfluidics, biosensors, and smart systems, translating research into practical technologies and enabling technology transfer. As Founding Investigator of the MMNE (MEMS, Microfluidics and Nanoelectronics) Lab and Head of CREST (Center for Research Excellence in Semiconductor Technologies), he organizes training programs, hands-on courses, and colloquia that connect academia, government and industry, while offering access to advanced design practices and state-of-the-art equipment. A co-founder of three spin-offs, Cleome, Pyrome, and Sensome, he fosters indigenous innovation and career development. In the classroom, he has restructured curricula with industry-aligned, lab-intensive courses integrating cleanroom practice, simulations, and design sprints. Having mentored over 2,000 learners, his teaching blends conceptual clarity with hands-on rigor, delivering impactful outcomes in healthcare, environment and affordable diagnostics.

name: Prof. S Siva Sathya
citation: Dr. S. Siva Sathya, Professor, Department of Computer Science at Pondicherry University, is a distinguished academician with over 25 years of service in higher education. She has played a pivotal role in curriculum design, student mentorship, and promoting experiential learning. Her research bridges AI and societal impact, particularly in healthcare, through collaborations with premier institutes. She developed MITRA, a women’s safety application, earning the prestigious “Naari Shakti Puraskar” from the Hon’ble President of India, recognizing her excellence in leveraging technology for social good. Beyond technology, she nurtures a deep passion for art and yoga.

name: Dr. Nilakshi Subhash Jain
school: Shah and Anchor Kutchhi Engineering College, Mumbai, Maharashtra
citation: Dr. Nilakshi Jain is Head of the Cyber Security Department at Shah and Anchor Kutchhi Engineering College, Mumbai with 17+ years of teaching and research experience. She integrates Outcome-Based Education with NEP 2020, making learning practical and impactful. She is author of textbooks on cyber security and AI which serve as reference materials for students. She has also published papers and filed patents in areas like digital forensics, deepfake detection, and secure infrastructure. She also mentors students in hackathons and start-ups and also conducts cyber awareness project through bootcamps and rural campaigns to create ethical, cyber literate and skilled cyber defenders for Digital India.

name: Prof. Manoj B S
school: Central Sanskrit University, Bhopal Campus, Madhya Pradesh
citation: Prof. Manoj BS is working as a Senior Professor and Associate Dean, Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology (IIST), Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. He has developed several teaching innovations including DeepTeaching enabling high-impact experiential learning for students. His DeepTeaching method blends Technology-Integrated Teaching, Mentee-Centric Mentoring (MCM), and Multi-Track Modular Teaching (MT2). MT2 enables multi-modal learning by creating various activity tracks within an academic course. His research areas include computer networks, AI, satellite networks, brain computer interfaces, wireless ad hoc and mesh networks and complex networks. He published widely in international peer-reviewed publications including textbooks, journal publications and international conference publications. His research is widely cited with more than 7300 citations, an h-index of 33, and an i-10 index of 91.

name: Prof. Shankar Sriram Sankaran
disc: Engineering & Architecture Computer Science and Engineering
school: SASTRA Deemed University, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu
citation: Dr. V. S. Shankar Sriram is a Professor and Dean, School of Computing, SASTRA Deemed University, having over 24 years of experience promoting experiential and adaptive learning. His research focuses on AI, Network Security and Cyber-Physical Systems. He has mentored many Ph.D. scholars, securing a patent and developing an indigenous Intrusion Detection System for SCADA/OT, successfully transferred to industry. With an h-index of 22 and i10-index of 40, he has published extensively, created AR/VR content for STEM education, and advanced AI-driven solutions in Alternate Dispute Resolution. He serves on several academic & research advisory boards and continues to drive excellence through sponsored research, FDPs, consultancy, and innovative educational initiatives. He has conducted cybersecurity awareness programs for government agencies, including the Tamil Nadu Police and the Indian Air Force.

name: Prof. Vineeth N B
disc: Engineering & Architecture Computer Science and Engineering
citation: He is a Faculty at Department of Computer Science & Engineering and Artificial Intelligence. His major areas of interest are Deep Learning, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Explainable AI and Reasoning. His endeavour is to make the latest topics in these fields accessible to students nationwide and beyond. By making complex concepts engaging and understandable, his courses have inspired many students to specialize and pursue careers in AI, deep learning and computer vision. He has also designed NPTEL Online Course on “Deep Learning for Computer Vision” Furthermore, his dedication to mentoring has fostered the growth of numerous aspiring AI researchers, significantly shaping the future of the field in the country.

name: Prof. Vibha Sharma
school: Department of English, Faculty of Arts, Aligarh Muslim University, Uttar Pradesh
citation: Dr. Vibha Sharma, Professor in the Department of English at Aligarh Muslim University, integrates performance, workshops, interactive and innovative pedagogies, combining theatre studies with Indian knowledge systems. She has developed the MOOC Course under SWAYAM, Studies in Theatre, and led a GIAN course. An accomplished playwright and actor, she actively writes and performs in plays, mentoring students in theatre practice. She is also serving as a national-level faculty development resource person for Pandit Madan Mohan Malviya National Mission on Teachers and Teaching Centres (PMMTTCs). She also spearheads internships, outreach, and engages learners across India, especially the underprivileged.

name: Prof. Srivardhini Keshavamurthy Jha
citation: Srivardhini K. Jha, Professor of Entrepreneurship at IIM Bangalore, is committed to fostering a learning environment that is both rigorous and engaging. She has designed contemporary curricula, introduced innovative pedagogies, and developed contextually grounded content that enriches learning in both offline and online settings. Her experiential courses enable students to apply academic concepts to real-world challenges, making learning impactful and relevant. As Chairperson of N S Raghavan Centre for Entrepreneurial Learning (NSRCEL), IIMB’s startup incubator, she has played a pivotal role in shaping India’s entrepreneurial ecosystem. She has mentored thousands of entrepreneurs, supported ventures across diverse sectors, and spear headed initiatives that have strengthened incubation quality nationwide. Her influence extends into the policy domain, where she has contributed to Startup20, the National STIP 2020, and Karnataka’s Research, Development and Innovation Policy, thereby advancing the national discourse on entrepreneurship and innovation.

name: Prof. Amit Kumar Dwivedi
school: Entrepreneurship Development Institute of India, Gandhinagar, Gujarat
citation: Dr. Amit Kumar Dwivedi is a Professor at the Entrepreneurship Development Institute of India (EDII). He teaches courses on Family Business and New Venture Creation. His research expertise lies in Entrepreneurship Education and MSME Policy, with publications in leading peer-reviewed journals and books. Notably, he has co-authored many Global Entrepreneurship Monitor (GEM) India National Reports (2014-2024) and one International Report on Women Entrepreneurship. Additionally, he has authored many Reports on Tourism Entrepreneurship for various state governments. Dr. Dwivedi collaborates with state governments to design long-duration integrated projects on Entrepreneurship Education and Student Entrepreneurship. Currently, he is leading student entrepreneurship and MSME development projects in Uttarakhand, Ladakh, Chhattisgarh, Pondicherry, Gujarat, Odisha and other regions.

name: Dr. Zoramdinthara
citation: Dr. Zoramdinthara is a faculty at Department of Mizo, Mizoram University and has 19 years of teaching experience. He has published many research papers and presented multiple research papers as a resource person at state, national and international platforms. He has authored three books—Mizo Fiction: Emergence and Development, Green Pasture, and Thingsiri Par—and edited three volumes. He has been honored with many awards for social service and community involvement. He promotes diverse pedagogical methods and educational technology. For promotion of Mizo literature, he conducts various literary writing competition among the students and observed important international literary days. Beyond academics, he promotes student well-being through health, environmental, and life-skill programs under NSS, emphasizing holistic education, critical thinking, and nation-building.

name: Prof. Ganesh Timmanna Pandit
citation: Shri Ganesh Timanna Pandit is a Professor at Central Sanskrit University, New Delhi. He has developed instructional material for Shiksha Shastri I & II Year students. He has supervised many PhD scholars and has various publications in journals and non-journals to his credit. He has also been resource person in various faculty development programmes held from time to time in various universities. He has been involved in multiple research projects. Besides his academic duties, he has also contributed to academic/campus activities as member of various committees in the University.

name: Dr. Proshanto Kumar Saha
school: Rajiv Gandhi University - A Central University, Papum Pare, Arunachal Pradesh
citation: Dr. Proshanto Kr. Saha is a Faculty at Department of Psychology specializing in Forensic Psychology and Neuropsychology at Rajiv Gandhi Central University, Arunachal Pradesh. With over 14 years of experience, Dr. Saha has demonstrated a profound commitment to educational excellence by establishing Neuropsychology Laboratory and development of Neurofeedback Intervention Training Modules. His scholarly pursuits are marked by research output in reputed journals and bolstered by securing major sponsored research projects (DST, ANRF, DHR-ICMR etc.). Dr. Saha is also committed to social outreach, offering psychological support to child abuse victims and leading faculty development initiatives. His work reflects a strong dedication to academic excellence and societal improvement, demonstrating a holistic approach to his profession.

name: Dr. Menda Devananda Kumar
school: Dr. Lakireddy Hanimireddy Government Degree College, Mylavaram, Andhra Pradesh
citation: Dr. M. Devananda Kumar is a Faculty of the Department of Telugu at Dr. Lakireddy Hanimireddy Government Degree College in Mylavaram, Andhra Pradesh. Dr. Devananda Kumar's outstanding contributions have been recognized with prestigious accolades. He is a passionate innovator in education, known for his best practices, which include the intricate art of creating thallapatra granthas (palm-leaf manuscripts) and the production of educational videos for the Student Learning Management System (LMS).

name: Prof. Purushottam Balasaheb Pawar
school: SVPM Institute of Technology and Engineering, Baramati, Pune, Maharashtra
citation: Prof. Purushottam Balasaheb Pawar is lecturer in Mechanical Engineering Department and his teaching philosophy is centered on active learning, employing dynamic methods and implementing best practices such as interactive walls to create an engaging classroom environment. He has actively promoted IPR awareness and cultivated a love for reading by starting a dedicated Readers' Club for his students. Beyond the classroom, he has championed innovation and entrepreneurship, guiding students through the development of socially impactful projects under initiatives like Mission Clean City, which have secured various state and national-level awards. His academic contributions include the publication of five books and more than thirty papers. Through the successful implementation of Outcome-Based Education (OBE), he has focused on empowering students to achieve tangible, real-world outcomes. These efforts collectively demonstrate a dedication to holistic student development and academic excellence.

name: Shri Urvish Pravinkumar Soni
citation: Prof. Urvish Soni is a Lecturer in the Department of Instrumentation and Control Engineering. With prior industrial experience at Reliance Industries, he brings real-world exposure into academics. He established the Project and Innovation Lab, a model startup ecosystem, and initiated the One Student One Skill Momentum to nurture employable and entrepreneurial skills in every student. His efforts focus on transforming classrooms into hubs of creativity and problem-solving, enabling students to design affordable, community-driven solutions. His work reflects a perfect blend of academic excellence, innovation and social responsibility.

name: Dr. A. Gandhimathi
school: Thiagarajar Polytechnic College, Salem, Tamil Nadu
citation: Dr. A. Gandhimathi, with 16 years of experience at Thiagarajar Polytechnic College, is known for creating an exceptional learning environment through pioneering Student-Centric Learning, Tech Talk, and Employer-Centric Learning, leading to 99% academic success for her students.She was conferred with the prestigious AICTE Lilavati Award 2021 for her leadership in the Team Literacy and Life Skills program serving underprivileged women in Upparapatti village. She has excelled in 9 NPTEL courses, earning 4 Gold and 2 Silver medals.A lifelong learner, she has published 22 research papers, authored 10 articles, participated in over 100 training sessions, and serves as a dedicated mentor who ignites a passion for research, leading to innovative projects and patents.
core: Student-centric learning, academic excellence, women empowerment, research mentorship, and community engagement.

name: Prof. Parmar Ranjitkumar Khimjibhai
citation: Prof. Parmar Ranjitkumar Khimjibhai has more than 23 years of teaching experience and currently serves as the Head of the Department of Electrical Engineering at Government Polytechnic, Junagadh, Gujarat.He follows an innovative Gurukul style of teaching, blending moral and ethical values with modern teaching tools such as live internet and animation. He strongly promotes experiment-based and project-based learning requiring multidisciplinary skills.Under his leadership, the department secured accreditation from the National Board of Accreditation, New Delhi for six consecutive years. He has also prepared laboratory manuals and instructional videos in the local language, making technical education more accessible to students from rural and underprivileged backgrounds.
core: Innovative Gurukul-style pedagogy, academic leadership, accreditation excellence, and inclusive technical education.

name: Prof. Nidhi Jain
school: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi, New Delhi
citation: Prof. Nidhi Jain has 16 years of teaching experience and is a Professor in the Department of Chemistry at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi. She is internationally recognized for her contributions to the rapidly advancing fields of C–H functionalization and photoredox catalysis in organic synthesis.Her scientific work has resulted in more than 80 research publications in leading international journals, accumulating over 3,900 citations with an h-index of 25. Under her guidance, her research group has developed sustainable synthetic methodologies that expand the chemical space of heterocyclic compounds with significant potential therapeutic value. As an educator, she has a strong record of teaching excellence and has delivered highly appreciated online lectures for the IIT–Professor Assisted Learning (IIT-PAL) program, inspiring and supporting high school students nationwide.
core: Excellence in chemical research, sustainable synthesis, high-impact teaching, and national-level academic outreach.

name: Prof. Dr. A.S. Smiline Girija
school: Centre for Infectious Diseases, Saveetha Dental College and Hospitals Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences Saveetha University, Chennai, Tamil Nadu
citation: Prof. Dr. A.S. Smiline Girija has over 22 years of experience in the field of medical microbiology and is an alumnus of PGIBMS, University of Madras. Her innovative teaching philosophy emphasizes experiential and student-centered learning to address diverse learner needs.She has pioneered structured pedagogical frameworks such as Do–Observe–Record– Arrange (DORA) and Joyful Integrative Learning & Update (JILU). To further enrich learning outcomes, she implemented the Multiple Integrative Learning Algorithm (MILA), complemented by game-based and digital assessment tools including CHIKKU, Micro-Innova, Social Media Integrated Learning in Education (SMILE), and Open-Read-Orient (OREO).Her classroom practices integrate Process Oriented Guided Inquiry Learning (POGIL), peer-led discussions, and critical pedagogy. She also bridges theory and clinical practice by embedding Evidence-Based Dentistry (EBD), case-based clinical examinations, and advanced molecular methodologies into the curriculum, transforming traditional lecture-based education.
core: Innovative medical microbiology pedagogy, experiential learning models, integration of digital and game-based assessments, and clinical-academic curriculum bridging.

name: Prof. Birinchi Kumar Sarma
school: Banaras Hindu University (BHU) Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh
citation: Prof. Birinchi Kumar Sarma, a distinguished faculty member in Mycology and Plant Pathology at the Institute of Agricultural Sciences, Banaras Hindu University (BHU), is widely admired for his enthusiastic and transformative teaching approaches. With over 22 years of experience at BHU, he has played a significant role in building student capacity through innovative, real-world oriented learning. He fosters creative inquiry by engaging students with stakeholders, identifying practical challenges, and encouraging innovative thinking. He has developed two Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs) and supported Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs) to promote entrepreneurship and applied learning. As Chairman of the Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Cell, he has guided innovators in protecting their work through patents. He leads the experiential learning program on “Biofertilizer and Biopesticide Production”, enabling final-year undergraduate students to become industry-ready and pursue start-ups. Through initiatives such as the flagship program “Finding the Leader in You (FLY)”, he actively nurtures leadership qualities among students.
core: Experiential and entrepreneurial learning, intellectual property mentoring, capacity building, and leadership development in agricultural education.

name: Prof. Srinivas Hotha
school: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER), Pune Maharashtra
citation: Prof. Srinivas Hotha has over 21 years of teaching experience and is a highly passionate chemistry educator at the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER), Pune. He has inspired and mentored numerous undergraduate and postgraduate students by developing innovative pedagogical tools for effective classroom teaching. He discovered the first gold-catalyzed glycosidation reaction and developed a suite of experimental protocols. His research group has synthesized complex and branched glycan probes that contribute to vaccine development for Mycobacterium tuberculosis . Under his leadership, the TLC–MS Interface, named SWADESI (Software Assisted Direct Extraction and Sampling Interface), was invented to enable rapid confirmation of molecular weights of drugs and pharmaceuticals. He has also authored over 100 research publications, reflecting his significant impact on chemical education and research.
core: Innovative chemistry pedagogy, pioneering glycoscience research, translational scientific tools, and excellence in academic mentorship.

name: Prof. S.R. Keshava
citation: Prof. S.R. Keshava has 26 years of experience as a passionate professor of Economics at Bangalore University, Karnataka. He strongly believes in experiential learning and actively organizes outreach activities, including visits to industries, start-ups, and farmlands, to provide students with first-hand exposure to real-world economic environments. To enrich classroom instruction, he curates comprehensive reading lists and integrates ICT-enabled teaching methodologies such as online academic resources, YouTube-based learning content, and Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs). These blended learning strategies have significantly enhanced student engagement and conceptual understanding. His most cited research works include studies on foreign direct investment, socio-economic exclusion of Indian farmers, and urbanization and solid waste management in Bangalore, reflecting his commitment to addressing pressing economic and policy challenges through teaching and research.
core: Experiential economics education, ICT-enabled teaching, impactful policy research, and student-centered outreach initiatives.

name: Prof. Shilpagauri Prasad Ganpule
school: Pune District Education Association’s Prof. Ramkrishna More Arts, Commerce and Science College Pune, Maharashtra
citation: Prof. Shilpagauri Prasad Ganpule has 30 years of distinguished teaching experience and has played a significant leadership role in higher education. She served as the lead of the 84th Poets, Essayists, Novelists (PEN) Congress, demonstrating her commitment to literary scholarship and global academic engagement. Her teaching methodology emphasizes experiential learning and strong ICT integration. She effectively uses digital platforms such as Google Classroom and Zoom to enhance student engagement and interactive learning outcomes. She was the Principal Investigator for the Hedra Research Associates’ “Covid Metaphor Project” and was appointed as a Peace Ambassador by the Institute of Economics and Peace, Sydney, Australia. Additionally, she has been recognized as the Director of the International Fellowship of Rotarian Educators, reflecting her global academic and humanitarian contributions.
core: Experiential and ICT-enabled English pedagogy, international academic leadership, peace education advocacy, and research-driven literary scholarship.

name: Dr. C. Jaya Sankar Babu
role: Associate Professor & Head Department of Hindi
citation: Dr. C. Jaya Sankar Babu has 16 years of academic experience as an Associate Professor and Head of the Department of Hindi at Pondicherry University. A committed teacher and researcher, he has made significant contributions toward student skill development and employability. As the Founder Editor of “Yug Manas” and Chief Editor of “Antar Bharati” , he has actively engaged with mainstream media and conducted scholarly research in journalism. He has played a vital role in promoting e-literacy, particularly in computing in Indian languages. He initiated a Digital Literacy Mission in 1999 and has since organized more than 1,700 workshops over the past two and a half decades. He has developed MOOCs for the SWAYAM platform, implemented research projects, and has been honored with multiple awards, including the Best Teacher Award from Pondicherry University on three occasions.
core: Promotion of Indian language computing, digital and e-literacy initiatives, journalism research, and student skill development in higher education.

name: Prof. Nilabh Tiwari
school: Central Sanskrit University, Bhopal Campus, Madhya Pradesh
citation: Prof. Nilabh Tiwari has 18 years of teaching experience and is a distinguished educator and academic leader in the field of education and Sanskrit studies. As a prolific author and editor, he has made substantial contributions to academic literature, authoring and editing 34 books and journals and publishing 37 research papers in reputed journals. His scholarly work addresses diverse areas including Indian knowledge-based educational psychology, information and communication technology (ICT), and curriculum development. He has played a pivotal role in advancing research and innovation in education through evidence-based academic practices. Prof. Tiwari has demonstrated exceptional leadership in spearheading the orientation programs for the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020. His professional experience spans curriculum design, educational surveys, research and development initiatives, and the creation of comprehensive teacher orientation and capacity-building programs.
core: Academic leadership in education, Indian knowledge systems, NEP 2020 implementation, curriculum development, and teacher capacity building.

name: Prof. Vinay Sharma
school: Joint Professor, Dept. of Design, IIT Roorkee, Uttarakhand
citation: Prof. Vinay Sharma, with around 30 years of experience, is a Professor in the Department of Management Studies and also a Joint Professor in the Department of Design at IIT Roorkee. He has contributed significantly to marketing innovation literature, with one of his theories acknowledged by the Academy of Marketing Science. He has been part of the working group for the Ganga River Basin Environment Management Plan and executed projects in low-cost energy generation and livelihood development in the North-Western Himalayas, which have been patented, tested, and commercialized. In his book, ‘Affordability for the Poor and Profitability for the Provider’, he proposed a specialized model recognized on various platforms. Prof. Sharma has trained around 5000 senior executives, including Managing Directors, CEOs, and Senior Managers of large corporations and multinationals.

name: Dr. Nandavaram Mrudula
school: Department of Telugu Govt. Degree College for Women, Begumpet, Hyderabad, Telangana
citation: Dr. Nandavaram Mrudula is an Associate Professor and Head of the Department of Telugu at the Government Degree College for Women, Begumpet, Hyderabad, with an illustrious teaching career spanning 34 years. Her teaching methodology is deeply student-centric, emphasizing critical thinking and contextual understanding. A significant portion of her career has been dedicated to serving rural areas, where she actively engaged in outreach initiatives to support students struggling with academic fees and extended humanitarian support to homeless individuals. Dr. Mrudula’s pedagogical approach inspires thought-provoking inquiry by presenting even classical lessons through contemporary perspectives, seamlessly integrating current affairs and future societal demands. Her commitment to inclusive education and social responsibility has had a lasting impact on both her students and the wider community.
core: Student-centric pedagogy, Telugu language education, rural outreach, social service, and inclusive higher education.

name: Dr. Shimi S.L.
school: Electrical Engineering Department Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh
citation: Dr. Shimi S.L. is an Associate Professor in the Electrical Engineering Department at Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh, with 21 years of extensive academic and research experience. Her areas of specialization include Power Electronics and Drives, Electro-mobility, Power Quality, Advanced Control Theory, Soft Computing Techniques, and hardware implementation. She completed her postdoctoral research in Electromobility at Luleå Technical University, Sweden (2019–2021). She was awarded an Indian Patent for a “Multilevel Inverter” in February 2024 and has co-investigated the DST Chandigarh-funded project “Emergency Vehicle Preemption.” She is currently investigating a project on measurement-based impact studies of solar PV and electric vehicle integration into the grid. Dr. Shimi played a key role in establishing the Centre of Excellence in Hardware-in-Loop (HIL) Simulation in collaboration with Typhoon HIL, Switzerland. She has also contributed to several real-time projects, including solar-powered smart classrooms, IoT-based smart laboratories, and EV charging stations. During 2018–19, she developed MOOCs under the SWAYAM platform on Real-Time Power System Analysis and Smart Grid, significantly contributing to technology-enabled learning.
core: Power electronics, electromobility, smart grids, renewable energy integration, applied research, innovation, and technology-enabled education.

name: Prof. Kapil Ahuja
school: Department of Computer Science and Engineering IIT Indore, Madhya Pradesh
citation: Prof. Kapil Ahuja is a Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at IIT Indore with 14 years of teaching and research experience in India and the United States. A four-time recipient of the Best Teacher Award at IIT Indore, his teaching methodology emphasizes open-ended, project-based learning that fosters critical thinking and innovation. He also initiated the first Master of Science by Research (MSR) program at IIT Indore. Prof. Ahuja has successfully executed fifteen sponsored research projects and has published forty-four research papers. His notable work includes modeling social cloud systems as strategic network formation games and proposing the novel concept of Bilateral Stability, enabling organizations to create more efficient collaborative networks. Beyond academics, he served as the founding Dean of International Affairs at IIT Indore, playing a pivotal role in establishing and strengthening the institute’s global collaborations.
core: Innovative pedagogy, computer science research, project-based learning, strategic network modeling, and academic leadership.

name: Dr. Anitha Suseelan
school: School of Architecture CHRIST University, Bangalore, Karnataka
citation: Dr. Anitha Suseelan is Professor and Head of the School of Architecture at CHRIST University, Bangalore, with over 30 years of experience in Architecture, Urban Design, and Rural Design studies. She pioneered the Rural Studio Program Mission in academia, extending architectural education into rural India through experiential learning and impactful research. Her pedagogy emphasizes student skill development, utilization of local resources and labour, and environmentally low-impact, innovative modular design suited for ecologically and socially sensitive contexts. Dr. Suseelan is a recipient of several prestigious national and international recognitions, including ICSSR funding, Times Higher Education Asia Award 2024 (Top 8), Lafarge Holcim Participation Award 2021, London Design Biennale 2021, Sir Patrick Geddes Award, Vastu Shilpa Foundation Award, Prof. J.C. Alexander Memorial Endowment, and the Sthapathi Samman.
core: Experiential architectural pedagogy, rural and sustainable design, community-oriented architecture, and innovation in higher education.

name: Prof. Shahanaz Ayub
school: Bundelkhand Institute of Engineering & Technology Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh
citation: Prof. Shahanaz Ayub has 25 years of experience with the Department of Electronics & Communication Engineering at the Bundelkhand Institute of Engineering & Technology, Jhansi. She has extensive expertise in both industrial research and teaching and has been recognized for her outstanding contributions to engineering education. She was conferred with the prestigious AICTE Visvesvaraya Best Teacher Award (2021) . Prof. Ayub serves as a Mentor of Change under NITI Aayog’s ATAL Tinkering Labs initiative. To promote innovation, start-ups, and entrepreneurship among students, faculty, and staff, she introduced a credit course on Idea to Business Model and played a pivotal role in establishing an Incubation Centre at her institute.
core: Engineering education, innovation and entrepreneurship development, industrial research integration, and start-up ecosystem building.

name: Dr. Subbiah Brindha
school: PSG Polytechnic College, Coimbatore Tamil Nadu
citation: Dr. Subbiah Brindha is a passionate teacher and Head of the Computer Networking department at PSG Polytechnic College, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. She has over 20 years of experience teaching diploma students, many of whom consider her a role model. She actively encourages young girls to pursue careers in computer networking, a traditionally male-dominated sector. Despite multiple offers from degree institutions, Dr. Brindha chose to continue at the polytechnic, recognizing the critical impact on students from socio-economically backward backgrounds. She has developed strong industry connections, enabling students to secure internships and employment, and helped establish an industry-sponsored IoT laboratory. Under her leadership, a new Diploma Programme in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning was launched. Dr. Brindha also played a key role in obtaining NBA Accreditation for the Computer Engineering department in 2011 and 2021 — a commendable achievement for a diploma institution.
core: Diploma education leadership, industry collaboration, female student empowerment, and program accreditation.

name: Smt Mehta Zankhana Dilipbhai
citation: Smt. Mehta Zankhana Dilipbhai is a Lecturer in the Department of Instrumentation and Control Engineering at Government Polytechnic, Ahmedabad, Gujarat. She teaches Instrumentation and Control Engineering and Automation & Robotics Engineering and is extremely popular among her students. Beyond academics, she motivates students to pursue entrepreneurial ventures by developing innovative products and technologies. She established the Project and Innovation Lab and has overseen multiple projects. The Government of Gujarat recognized her efforts in mentoring innovation and start-up activities for diploma students by awarding her the “SSIP Prashansa Award-2020”. Smt. Mehta also serves as a Psychological Counsellor, available to students even after office hours. She contributes to curriculum development as a member of the board of studies for new courses like Automation and Robotics Engineering and mentors degree engineering students during internships.
core: Mentoring, innovation, entrepreneurship, student counselling, and curriculum development.

name: Prof. Keshav Kashinath Sangle
school: Veermata Jijabai Technological Institute, Mumbai, Maharashtra
citation: Prof. Keshav Kashinath Sangle is a highly effective and popular teacher, a competent administrator, and an excellent researcher. With over two decades of experience, he has developed an innovative teaching methodology by integrating learnings from live industry, government, and research projects into his pedagogy, with strong emphasis on problem-solving. He has innovatively revised curricula in alignment with NEP and implemented government programs like Prerna, Margdarshan, and TEQIP-II Mentor-Mentee schemes to support students and engineering colleges nationwide. He also founded a Skill Development Centre for the Maharashtra State Government, enhancing employability for rural students in Ratnagiri District. Prof. Sangle holds membership in multiple national and international professional bodies.
core: Innovative pedagogy, curriculum development, mentoring, and skill development for rural students.

name: Dr. S.R. Mahadeva Prasanna
school: Indian Institute of Technology, Dharwad, Karnataka
citation: Dr. S.R. Mahadeva Prasanna is a Professor of Electronics & Communication Engineering at IIT Dharwad, Karnataka. Coming from a family of educators, his passion for teaching is reflected in his methodology and excellent student feedback. He played a pivotal role in the development of IIT Guwahati and the establishment of IIT Dharwad. He introduced specialized courses such as speech processing, neural networks, and deep learning, tailoring them for students from diverse departments, enabling them to secure admissions in esteemed institutions nationally and internationally. Dr. Prasanna actively mentors faculty from other engineering colleges in teaching, research, and project proposal writing. His initiatives include multiple faculty development programs, workshops, conferences, invited talks, and cultural events. He also fosters industry-academia collaborations and guides research groups, enriching both campus and external institutions.
core: Innovative teaching, mentorship, faculty development, and research-industry collaboration.

name: Dr. Dinesh Babu J
school: International Institute of Information Technology, Bangalore, Karnataka
citation: Dr. Dinesh Babu is an Associate Professor at IIIT Bangalore, Karnataka. Renowned for highly engaging lectures, he has developed a unique problem-theory-practice methodology for teaching complex theories in a simple and effective way. He has implemented best practices for teaching large classes (300+ students), including weekly student feedback. His online course on Predictive Analytics has benefited thousands of students. Beyond his institution, Dr. Babu actively supports rural and secondary school students. He participated in the Excite program at IIITB and developed a Virtual Reality interview platform, employing AI and VR with five virtual interviewers, now adopted by Karnataka government's minority affairs department to train rural students for competitive exams.
core: Innovative teaching, large-class pedagogy, VR-based student training, and mentorship.

name: Dr. Farheen Bano
school: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh
citation: Dr. Farheen Bano is a highly inspiring assistant professor at AKTU, Lucknow. She teaches Architectural Design, Drawing, History, Services, Energy Conservation, and Simulation. Beyond deep subject knowledge, she guides students in creative thinking, critical analysis, and overall personality development, significantly impacting their personal and professional growth. Dr. Bano actively encourages students to pursue research in Architecture and is a go-to mentor for brainstorming, doubt clearance, field research, and career guidance. Her empathetic, non-judgmental approach has created long-lasting bonds with students. Awards and recognition include: - International Best Researcher in Architecture Award, Rula Awards: Research Peace Awards (2019) - Best Teacher Award, AKTU Lucknow (2021) - Outstanding Teacher Award (उ कृ ट fश क पुर कार), International Institute of Organized Research (I2OR), Government of India (2022)
core: Architectural teaching, research mentorship, creative pedagogy, and student guidance.

name: Shri Suman Chakraborty
citation: Prof. Suman Chakraborty is a distinguished professor in the Department of Mechanical Engineering at IIT Kharagpur. He established India’s first-ever global-standard Microfluidics Lab and developed innovative frugal bench-top experiments for effective teaching and learning, which evolved into high-quality products. He mentors a broad spectrum of students, including Post-Docs, Ph.D. scholars (50+), masters, graduates, and even school students. His primary focus is on interdisciplinary areas and emerging technologies.
