Prof. Chakraborty also guides student-driven start-ups and trains socially-challenged rural entrepreneurs, especially girls, in creating sustainable rural healthcare enterprises. His excellence has been recognized with multiple national and international accolades, including: - Fellowship of the American Physical Society - Fellowship of the Royal Society of Chemistry - Fellowship of the American Society of Mechanical Engineering - Infosys Prize - Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize (Government of India) Prof. Chakraborty is celebrated as both a passionate teacher and an outstanding researcher, widely regarded among the best at IIT Kharagpur.
core: Microfluidics, interdisciplinary research, innovative pedagogy, and student mentorship.

name: Shri Sayam Sen Gupta
citation: Shri Sayam Sen Gupta is a Professor in the Department of Chemical Sciences at IISER Kolkata. He is an excellent teacher and researcher, actively involved in science outreach, particularly among municipal school students. He ran a corporate-funded “Exciting Science” group for a decade, which aimed to convey the excitement of science and technology to school students. His group adopted three Pune Municipal Corporation Schools, where weekly science club sessions helped students learn the scientific method—making observations, framing hypotheses, reaching conclusions, and formulating research questions. In addition to his teaching outreach, Prof. Sen Gupta has undertaken several sponsored research projects funded by SERB and DST.
core: Science education outreach, chemical sciences research, mentoring school students.

name: Dr. Chandragouda Raosaheb Patil
school: R.C. Patel Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research, Shirpur, Dist. Dhule, Maharashtra
citation: Dr. Chandragouda Raosaheb Patil is a Professor in the Department of Pharmacology at R.C. Patel Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research, Shirpur, with over 20 years of teaching experience. He strives to make himself accessible to students using modern pedagogical tools. A pharmacologist by profession, he has developed software and hardware tools in his field, used for more than two decades by teachers and students in Pharmacy, Medical, and paramedical institutions across India and abroad. His artificial mice device gained prominence after the ban on animal-based experiments and dissections. Dr. Patil’s contributions have been recognized with awards such as “The Best Presentation Award” and “Young Scientist Award” from World Congresses on Alternatives to Animals in Life Sciences (Rome, Italy and Tokyo, Japan), as well as the “Innovator Teacher Award” from the Education Ministry and “Young Scientist Award” from the AYUSH Ministry.
core: Pharmacology education, development of educational tools, innovative alternatives to animal experimentation.

name: Dr. Raghavan B. Sunoj
citation: Dr. Raghavan B. Sunoj is an outstanding Chemistry Professor at IIT Bombay, renowned for inspiring and motivating young students to pursue science as a career. He has played a key role in outreach programs such as the national-level "Teach Ten Thousand College Teachers" initiative, and has actively promoted problem-solving approaches to organic chemistry for rural colleges. He has contributed to summer school programs in theoretical and organic chemistry and guided students through innovative learning methods. Dr. Sunoj’s excellence in teaching has been recognized with multiple awards, including the Prof. S. P. Sukhatme Excellence in Teaching Award (IIT Bombay, 2017) and the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Chemical Sciences (2019). His students consider him among the best teachers at IIT Bombay.

name: Prof. Indranath Sengupta
citation: Prof. Indranath Sengupta is one of the most popular teachers at IIT Gandhinagar. Known for his approachable personality and excellent listening skills, his lucid teaching methods make complex mathematical theories engaging and accessible. Many of his students have gone on to become faculty members at premier Indian institutions, reflecting his profound impact. He dedicates hours to mentoring students, addressing their queries, and helping them overcome academic inhibitions. He also coordinates the Student Support Service cell at IIT Gandhinagar, promoting student welfare. Beyond classroom teaching, Prof. Sengupta actively participates in outreach activities and workshops to promote mathematics education nationwide. He strongly believes a teacher’s role is to teach “how to ask good questions” and has developed an online course module in Mathematics for e-PG Pathshala to reach students through digital resources.

name: Dr. Ashish Baldi
school: Maharaja Ranjit Singh Punjab Technical University, Bathinda, Punjab
citation: Dr. Ashish Baldi is currently Professor and Dean, Faculty of Pharmacy at Maharaja Ranjit Singh Punjab Technical University, Bathinda. With over 20 years of academic experience, he excels in innovative pedagogical approaches, creating an interactive and critical thinking-driven learning environment. Beyond exceptional teaching, his mentorship has shaped the professional paths of numerous students. As Chief Mentor of IDEA Lab, he has fostered an ecosystem for innovative and out-of-the-box thinking, resulting in the development of many student-driven products. Dr. Baldi combines student-centric academic excellence, impactful research, strong administrative skills, and societal contributions, establishing himself as a distinguished teacher in the field of Pharmacy.

name: Dr. Satya Ranjan Acharya
school: Entrepreneurship Development Institute of India, Bhat, Gandhinagar, Gujarat
citation: Dr. Satya Ranjan Acharya is Professor and Director of the Department of Entrepreneurship Education at the Entrepreneurship Development Institute of India. He specializes in training both budding and established entrepreneurs. His mentoring extends beyond classrooms, exemplified by the "Hastakala Setu" project, through which he supports over 20,000 traditional artisans across 33 districts of Gujarat in training, market exposure, and financial management. He is recognized for his teaching in courses such as New Enterprise Creation and Entrepreneurial Finance. Additionally, Dr. Acharya organizes and conducts management development programs and faculty development programs on entrepreneurship teaching and startup incubation, collaborating with the Government of Gujarat and the Ministry of Education.
